### 6. MOD-06: Analytics Engine

Event tracking, metric aggregation, custom dashboards, and data export

#### Flujo OAuth2 Authorization Code con PKCE para MOD-06El modulo Analytics Engine implementa el flujo OAuth2 Authorization Code con Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) para garantizar la maxima seguridad en la obtencion de tokens de acceso. Este flujo es obligatorio para todas las integraciones de tipo SPA (Single Page Application) y aplicaciones mobile. A continuacion se detalla cada paso del protocolo con los datos tecnicos de implementacion.

| Paso | Accion del Cliente                                                  | Endpoint del Servidor   | Metodo HTTP | Response                 | Validacion del Servidor                                     | Datos de Salida                    |
| ---- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ----------- | ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| 1    | Generar code_verifier aleatorio (43-128 chars)                      | N/A                     | N/A         | N/A                      | N/A                                                         | code_verifier: random string       |
| 2    | Calcular code_challenge = SHA256(code_verifier) base64url           | N/A                     | N/A         | N/A                      | N/A                                                         | code_challenge: hash               |
| 3    | Redirigir a /auth/authorize con state, code_challenge, redirect_uri | /api/auth/authorize     | GET         | 302 Redirect + auth page | Validar client_id, redirect_uri registrado                  | Authorization page                 |
| 4    | Usuario introduce credenciales + MFA                                | /api/auth/login         | POST        | 200 OK + set-cookie      | Rate limit, lockout, bcrypt verify                          | Session cookie (HttpOnly)          |
| 5    | Consentimiento de scopes (si aplica)                                | /api/auth/consent       | POST        | 302 Redirect + code      | Validar scopes solicitados vs permitidos                    | Authorization code (10 min TTL)    |
| 6    | Intercambiar code + code_verifier por tokens                        | /api/auth/token         | POST        | 200 OK + tokens JSON     | Verificar code_challenge, code Usage (1 use), client_secret | access_token + refresh_token       |
| 7    | Almacenar tokens de forma segura                                    | N/A                     | N/A         | N/A                      | N/A                                                         | Memory-only, no localStorage       |
| 8    | Refrescar access_token con refresh_token                            | /api/auth/token/refresh | POST        | 200 OK + new tokens      | Verificar refresh_token vigente, rotacion                   | Nuevo access_token + refresh_token |

#### Diagrama de Secuencia OAuth2 PKCE para MOD-06```text
  Cliente (SPA)                Auth Server                    Modulo Analytics Engine
      │                            │                              │
      │─── GET /auth/authorize ────>│                              │
      │    (state, code_challenge, │                              │
      │     redirect_uri, scope)   │                              │
      │                            │                              │
      │<── 302 Login Page ─────────│                              │
      │                            │                              │
      │─── POST /auth/login ──────>│                              │
      │    (email, password, mfa)  │                              │
      │<── 200 Set-Cookie ────────│                              │
      │                            │                              │
      │─── POST /auth/consent ────>│                              │
      │<── 302 + code ────────────│                              │
      │                            │                              │
      │─── POST /auth/token ──────>│                              │
      │    (code, code_verifier)   │                              │
      │<── 200 { access_token,    │                              │
      │        refresh_token,      │                              │
      │        expires_in,         │                              │
      │        token_type }        │                              │
      │                            │                              │
      │─── GET /api/analytics-engine ─────────────────────────────────────────>│
      │    Authorization: Bearer   │                              │
      │<── 200 Response ──────────────────────────────────────────│

```

#### Estructura JWT Detallada para MOD-06Los tokens JWT del modulo Analytics Engine contienen claims estandar (RFC 7519) mas claims personalizados para autorizacion granular. El header especifica el algoritmo RS256 con clave RSA de 2048 bits. Los claims se agrupan en categorias: identidad, sesion, autorizacion y metadatos.

| Claim       | Tipo     | Obligatorio | Descripcion                                   | Ejemplo                                             | Validacion                            |
| ----------- | -------- | ----------- | --------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| iss         | string   | Si          | Emisor del token (identificador del servicio) | "SW-AOE-auth"                                       | Debe coincidir con issuer configurado |
| sub         | string   | Si          | Identificador unico del usuario               | "usr_abc123xyz"                                     | Debe existir en tabla users           |
| aud         | string[] | Si          | Audiencia destino del token                   | ["SW-AOE-api", "SW-AOE-ws"]                         | Debe incluir audience esperada        |
| exp         | number   | Si          | Timestamp de expiracion (Unix epoch)          | 1700000900                                          | Debe ser > now + maxClockSkew         |
| iat         | number   | Si          | Timestamp de emision                          | 1700000000                                          | Debe ser <= now + maxClockSkew        |
| nbf         | number   | No          | Not Before — token no valido antes de         | 1700000000                                          | Debe ser <= now                       |
| jti         | string   | Si          | JWT ID — identificador unico del token        | "tok_abc123xyz"                                     | Debe ser unico (anti-replay)          |
| email       | string   | No          | Email verificado del usuario                  | "user@example.com                                   | Formato email valido                  |
| role        | string   | Si          | Rol primario del usuario                      | "admin"                                             | Debe ser rol valido del sistema       |
| permissions | string[] | Si          | Permisos granulares del usuario               | ["analytics-engine:read", "analytics-engine:write"] | Must match permission registry        |
| orgId       | string   | No          | Organizacion del usuario                      | "org_abc123"                                        | Debe existir en tabla orgs            |
| tenantId    | string   | Si          | Tenant para multi-tenancy                     | "tenant_xyz"                                        | Debe existir en tabla tenants         |
| mfaVerified | boolean  | Si          | Si MFA fue completado para este token         | true                                                | True para operaciones sensibles       |
| sessionId   | string   | Si          | Identificador de sesion activa                | "sess_abc123"                                       | Debe existir y estar activa           |
| scope       | string   | Si          | Scopes OAuth2 otorgados                       | "read write delete"                                 | Validar contra scopes permitidos      |

#### Implementacion del Middleware de Autenticacion para MOD-06```typescript
// src/lib/auth/mod-06-auth.middleware.ts
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { verifyToken, extractToken } from "@/lib/auth/token-verifier";
import { TokenBlacklist } from "@/lib/auth/token-blacklist";
import { RateLimiter } from "@/lib/security/rate-limiter";

// Configuracion de autenticacion para Analytics Engine
const MOD-06AuthConfig = {
  tokenSources: ["bearer", "cookie"],
  cookieName: "mod-06-session-token",
  issuer: "SW-AOE-auth",
  audience: ["SW-AOE-api"],
  algorithms: ["RS256"],
  clockTolerance: 30, // segundos
  maxAge: "15m",       // access token
  refreshMaxAge: "7d", // refresh token
  mfaRequiredFor: ["POST", "PUT", "DELETE"],
  mfaRequiredForPaths: ["/export", "/bulk"],
  rateLimit: {
    login: { max: 5, window: "15m" },
    tokenRefresh: { max: 10, window: "1h" },
    passwordReset: { max: 3, window: "1h" },
  },
  lockout: {
    maxAttempts: 5,
    baseDuration: 5 * 60 * 1000,   // 5 min
    maxDuration: 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000, // 24h
    backoffMultiplier: 2,
  },
};

export async function MOD-06AuthMiddleware(
  request: NextRequest
): Promise<NextResponse | { userId: string; token: DecodedToken }> {
  // 1. Extraer token de header o cookie
  const rawToken = extractToken(request, MOD-06AuthConfig);
  if (!rawToken) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "AUTH_REQUIRED", message: "Token de autenticacion ausente" },
      { status: 401 }
    );
  }

  // 2. Verificar token contra blacklist
  const blacklist = new TokenBlacklist();
  if (await blacklist.isBlacklisted(rawToken)) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "TOKEN_REVOKED", message: "Token ha sido revocado" },
      { status: 401 }
    );
  }

  // 3. Verificar firma y claims del JWT
  const payload = await verifyToken(rawToken, MOD-06AuthConfig);
  if (!payload) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "TOKEN_INVALID", message: "Token invalido o expirado" },
      { status: 401 }
    );
  }

  // 4. Verificar MFA para operaciones sensibles
  if (MOD-06AuthConfig.mfaRequiredFor.includes(request.method)) {
    if (!payload.mfaVerified) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "MFA_REQUIRED", message: "MFA requerido para esta operacion" },
        { status: 403 }
      );
    }
  }

  // 5. Inyectar metadata en request headers
  const requestHeaders = new Headers(request.headers);
  requestHeaders.set("x-user-id", payload.sub);
  requestHeaders.set("x-user-role", payload.role);
  requestHeaders.set("x-org-id", payload.orgId || "");
  requestHeaders.set("x-session-id", payload.sessionId);

  return { userId: payload.sub, token: payload };
}

```

#### Estrategias de Refresh Token para MOD-06La rotacion de refresh tokens es un mecanismo critico de seguridad que asegura que un token comprometido tenga una ventana de uso limitada. Cada vez que un refresh token se utiliza, el token original se invalida y se emite un nuevo par de tokens. El sistema detecta reutilizacion de tokens como indicio de compromiso.

| Politica              | Valor                         | Implementacion                           | Razon de Seguridad                 | Fallback                       |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| Rotacion por uso      | Cada refresh genera nuevo par | Eliminar old refresh token, emitir nuevo | Limitar ventana de compromiso      | Re-auth si rotation falla      |
| TTL del refresh token | 7 dias                        | Claim exp del refresh token              | Forzar re-auth periodica           | Recordar dispositivo (30 dias) |
| Reuso detectado       | Revocar toda la familia       | Token family tracking en DB              | Detectar robo de tokens            | Forzar re-login + MFA          |
| Max sesiones          | 3 por usuario                 | Session counter en Redis                 | Prevenir abuso                     | Revocar sesion mas antigua     |
| Idle timeout          | 30 minutos                    | Last activity timestamp                  | Proteger sesiones abandonadas      | Extender con actividad         |
| Absolute timeout      | 24 horas                      | Max age desde emision                    | Reducir ventana de exposicion      | N/A — forzar re-login          |
| IP binding            | Opcional (sensible)           | Hash de IP en token claim                | Deteccion de cambio de red         | Permitir rango subnet          |
| Device fingerprint    | SHA256 de UA+screen+locale    | Fingerprint en token claim               | Deteccion de cambio de dispositivo | Prompt de verificacion         |

## Autorizacion — RBAC Avanzado y ABAC — Detalle por Modulo

Las siguientes subsecciones proporcionan especificaciones detalladas para cada modulo funcional del sistema en el contexto de autorizacion — rbac avanzado y abac. Cada modulo incluye tablas de requisitos, matrices de trazabilidad, especificaciones tecnicas y criterios de aceptacion.

### 1. MOD-01: Core Application Service

Central orchestration of business logic and workflow coordination

#### Modelo RBAC Jerarquico para MOD-01El sistema de autorizacion del modulo Core Application Service implementa un modelo RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) con jerarquia de roles y herencia de permisos. Cada rol hereda todos los permisos del rol inmediatamente inferior, con la capacidad de anadir permisos adicionales o denegaciones explicitas. La jerarquia sigue el principio de minimo privilegio.

| Nivel | Rol         | Permisos Heredados            | Permisos Adicionales                                   | Denegaciones                                | Usuarios Tipicos              |
| ----- | ----------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| L0    | super_admin | Todos los permisos de admin   | System config, user management, billing, audit access  | Ninguna                                     | CTO, VP Engineering           |

#### Politicas ABAC (Attribute-Based Access Control) para MOD-01Ademas del RBAC jerarquico, el modulo Core Application Service soporta politicas ABAC que evaluan atributos contextuales en tiempo de decision. Las politicas ABAC complementan al RBAC permitiendo reglas mas granulares basadas en atributos del recurso, del usuario, del entorno y de la accion.

```typescript
// src/lib/auth/mod-01-abac.policy.ts

interface MOD-01PolicyContext {
  user: {
    id: string;
    role: string;
    orgId: string;
    department?: string;
    mfaVerified: boolean;
    ip: string;
    country: string;
  };
  resource: {
    type: string;       // "entity" | "report" | "config"
    id: string;
    ownerId: string;
    orgId: string;
    visibility: "public" | "org" | "private";
    sensitivity: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "restricted";
    locked: boolean;
    status: string;
  };
  action: "read" | "create" | "update" | "delete" | "export" | "admin";
  environment: {
    time: string;          // ISO 8601
    dayOfWeek: number;     // 0-6
    isBusinessHours: boolean;
    sourceIp: string;
    isVpn: boolean;
  };
}

// Definicion de politicas ABAC para Core Application Service
const MOD-01ABACpolicies: MOD-01Policy[] = [
  {
    id: "MOD-01-POL-001",
    name: "Acceso a recursos propios",
    effect: "allow",
    condition: (ctx) =>
      ctx.user.id === ctx.resource.ownerId &&
      ctx.action !== "delete" || ctx.user.role === "admin",
  },
  {
    id: "MOD-01-POL-002",
    name: "Restriccion de sensibilidad",
    effect: "deny",
    condition: (ctx) =>
      ctx.resource.sensitivity === "restricted" &&
      ctx.user.role !== "super_admin" &&
      !ctx.user.mfaVerified,
  },
  {
    id: "MOD-01-POL-003",
    name: "Bloqueo de recursos",
    effect: "deny",
    condition: (ctx) =>
      ctx.resource.locked &&
      ctx.user.role !== "super_admin",
  },
  {
    id: "MOD-01-POL-004",
    name: "Restriccion horaria para operaciones criticas",
    effect: "deny",
    condition: (ctx) =>
      (ctx.action === "delete" || ctx.action === "admin") &&
      !ctx.environment.isBusinessHours &&
      ctx.user.role !== "super_admin",
  },
  {
    id: "MOD-01-POL-005",
    name: "Acceso por visibilidad del recurso",
    effect: "allow",
    condition: (ctx) => {
      if (ctx.resource.visibility === "public") return true;
      if (ctx.resource.visibility === "org") return ctx.user.orgId === ctx.resource.orgId;
      return ctx.user.id === ctx.resource.ownerId;
    },
  },
];

```

#### Motor de Evaluacion de Permisos para MOD-01```typescript
// src/lib/auth/mod-01-permission-engine.ts

export class MOD-01PermissionEngine {
  private rolePermissions: Map<string, Set<string>>;
  private policies: MOD-01Policy[];
  private denyOverrides: Map<string, string[]>;

  constructor() {
    this.rolePermissions = new Map();
    this.policies = MOD-01ABACpolicies;
    this.denyOverrides = new Map([
      ["viewer", ["create", "update", "delete", "export", "admin", "bulk"]],
      ["guest", ["create", "update", "delete", "export", "admin", "bulk"]],
      ["editor", ["delete", "admin", "bulk"]],
      ["manager", ["delete", "admin"]],
    ]);
  }

  async check(context: MOD-01PolicyContext): Promise<{
    allowed: boolean;
    matchedPolicies: string[];
    deniedBy: string[];
  }> {
    const matchedPolicies: string[] = [];
    const deniedBy: string[] = [];

    // 1. Evaluar denegaciones explicitas por rol
    const roleDeny = this.denyOverrides.get(context.user.role) || [];
    if (roleDeny.includes(context.action)) {
      return {
        allowed: false,
        matchedPolicies,
        deniedBy: ["role_deny:" + context.action],
      };
    }

    // 2. Evaluar politicas ABAC (deny-first)
    for (const policy of this.policies) {
      if (policy.effect === "deny" && policy.condition(context)) {
        deniedBy.push(policy.id);
      }
      if (policy.condition(context)) {
        matchedPolicies.push(policy.id);
      }
    }

    if (deniedBy.length > 0) {
      return { allowed: false, matchedPolicies, deniedBy };
    }

    // 3. Evaluar permisos RBAC
    const permissions = this.rolePermissions.get(context.user.role);
    const hasPermission = permissions?.has(context.action) ?? false;

    // 4. Evaluar allow policies ABAC
    const hasAllowPolicy = this.policies.some(
      (p) => p.effect === "allow" && p.condition(context)
    );

    return {
      allowed: hasPermission || hasAllowPolicy,
      matchedPolicies,
      deniedBy,
    };
  }
}

```

### 2. MOD-02: Authentication Module

User identity management, session handling, token lifecycle, and MFA support

#### Modelo RBAC Jerarquico para MOD-02El sistema de autorizacion del modulo Authentication Module implementa un modelo RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) con jerarquia de roles y herencia de permisos. Cada rol hereda todos los permisos del rol inmediatamente inferior, con la capacidad de anadir permisos adicionales o denegaciones explicitas. La jerarquia sigue el principio de minimo privilegio.

| Nivel | Rol         | Permisos Heredados            | Permisos Adicionales                                   | Denegaciones                                | Usuarios Tipicos              |
| ----- | ----------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| L0    | super_admin | Todos los permisos de admin   | System config, user management, billing, audit access  | Ninguna                                     | CTO, VP Engineering           |
| L1    | admin       | Todos los permisos de manager | Delete any, bulk operations, module config, export all | No puede modificar system config            | Tech Lead, DevOps Lead        |
| L2    | manager     | Todos los permisos de editor  | Create/Update any in org, export org data, view audit  | No puede eliminar registros de otros        | Engineering Manager, PM       |
| L3    | editor      | Todos los permisos de viewer  | Create own, update own, export own data                | No puede ver registros privados de otros    | Senior Developer, Analyst     |
| L4    | viewer      | Permisos base de lectura      | Read public/org records, search, view metrics          | No puede escribir, exportar ni configurar   | Junior Developer, Stakeholder |
| L5    | guest       | Permiso minimo                | Read public records only                               | No puede acceder a datos de la organizacion | External collaborator         |
| L6    | api_service | Machine-to-machine            | Configurable scopes por API key                        | No puede acceder a UI features              | Service accounts, webhooks    |

// src/lib/auth/mod-02-permission-engine.ts

export class MOD-02PermissionEngine {
  private rolePermissions: Map<string, Set<string>>;
  private policies: MOD-02Policy[];

  constructor() {
    this.rolePermissions = new Map();
    this.policies = MOD-02ABACpolicies;
    this.denyOverrides = new Map([
      ["viewer", ["create", "update", "delete", "export", "admin", "bulk"]],
      ["guest", ["create", "update", "delete", "export", "admin", "bulk"]],
      ["editor", ["delete", "admin", "bulk"]],
      ["manager", ["delete", "admin"]],
    ]);
  }

  async check(context: MOD-02PolicyContext): Promise<{
    allowed: boolean;
    matchedPolicies: string[];
    deniedBy: string[];
  }> {
    const matchedPolicies: string[] = [];
    const deniedBy: string[] = [];

    // 1. Evaluar denegaciones explicitas por rol
    const roleDeny = this.denyOverrides.get(context.user.role) || [];
    if (roleDeny.includes(context.action)) {
      return {
        allowed: false,
        matchedPolicies,
        deniedBy: ["role_deny:" + context.action],
      };
    }

    // 2. Evaluar politicas ABAC (deny-first)
    for (const policy of this.policies) {
      if (policy.effect === "deny" && policy.condition(context)) {
        deniedBy.push(policy.id);
      }
      if (policy.condition(context)) {
        matchedPolicies.push(policy.id);
      }
    }

    if (deniedBy.length > 0) {
      return { allowed: false, matchedPolicies, deniedBy };
    }

    // 3. Evaluar permisos RBAC
    const permissions = this.rolePermissions.get(context.user.role);
    const hasPermission = permissions?.has(context.action) ?? false;

    // 4. Evaluar allow policies ABAC
    const hasAllowPolicy = this.policies.some(
      (p) => p.effect === "allow" && p.condition(context)
    );

    return {
      allowed: hasPermission || hasAllowPolicy,
      matchedPolicies,
      deniedBy,
    };
  }
}

```

### 3. MOD-03: Authorization Engine

RBAC with hierarchical roles, permission inheritance, and resource-level policies

#### Modelo RBAC Jerarquico para MOD-03El sistema de autorizacion del modulo Authorization Engine implementa un modelo RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) con jerarquia de roles y herencia de permisos. Cada rol hereda todos los permisos del rol inmediatamente inferior, con la capacidad de anadir permisos adicionales o denegaciones explicitas. La jerarquia sigue el principio de minimo privilegio.

| Nivel | Rol         | Permisos Heredados            | Permisos Adicionales                                   | Denegaciones                                | Usuarios Tipicos              |
| ----- | ----------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| L0    | super_admin | Todos los permisos de admin   | System config, user management, billing, audit access  | Ninguna                                     | CTO, VP Engineering           |
| L1    | admin       | Todos los permisos de manager | Delete any, bulk operations, module config, export all | No puede modificar system config            | Tech Lead, DevOps Lead        |
| L2    | manager     | Todos los permisos de editor  | Create/Update any in org, export org data, view audit  | No puede eliminar registros de otros        | Engineering Manager, PM       |
| L3    | editor      | Todos los permisos de viewer  | Create own, update own, export own data                | No puede ver registros privados de otros    | Senior Developer, Analyst     |
| L4    | viewer      | Permisos base de lectura      | Read public/org records, search, view metrics          | No puede escribir, exportar ni configurar   | Junior Developer, Stakeholder |
| L5    | guest       | Permiso minimo                | Read public records only                               | No puede acceder a datos de la organizacion | External collaborator         |
| L6    | api_service | Machine-to-machine            | Configurable scopes por API key                        | No puede acceder a UI features              | Service accounts, webhooks    |

| -------------------- | ----------- | ----- | ------- | --------------- | ------ | ----- | ------------------- | ------- |
| GET /list (public)   | Allow       | Allow | Allow   | Allow           | Allow  | Allow | Allow (scope)       | No      |
| GET /list (org)      | Allow       | Allow | Allow   | Allow           | Allow  | Deny  | Allow (scope)       | No      |
| GET /:id (own)       | Allow       | Allow | Allow   | Allow           | Allow  | Deny  | Allow (scope)       | No      |
| GET /:id (other)     | Allow       | Allow | Allow   | Deny            | Deny   | Deny  | Deny                | No      |
| GET /:id (sensitive) | Allow       | Allow | Allow   | Deny (override) | Deny   | Deny  | Deny                | Si      |
| POST / (create)      | Allow       | Allow | Allow   | Allow (own)     | Deny   | Deny  | Allow (scope)       | Si      |
| PUT /:id (own)       | Allow       | Allow | Allow   | Allow           | Deny   | Deny  | Allow (scope)       | Si      |
| PUT /:id (other)     | Allow       | Allow | Deny    | Deny            | Deny   | Deny  | Deny                | Si      |
| DELETE /:id          | Allow       | Allow | Deny    | Deny            | Deny   | Deny  | Allow (admin scope) | Si      |
| POST /bulk           | Allow       | Allow | Deny    | Deny            | Deny   | Deny  | Deny                | Si      |
| POST /export         | Allow       | Allow | Allow   | Allow (own)     | Deny   | Deny  | Allow (scope)       | Si      |

| PUT /config          | Allow       | Allow | Deny    | Deny            | Deny   | Deny  | Deny                | Si      |

#### Politicas ABAC (Attribute-Based Access Control) para MOD-03Ademas del RBAC jerarquico, el modulo Authorization Engine soporta politicas ABAC que evaluan atributos contextuales en tiempo de decision. Las politicas ABAC complementan al RBAC permitiendo reglas mas granulares basadas en atributos del recurso, del usuario, del entorno y de la accion.

```typescript
// src/lib/auth/mod-03-abac.policy.ts

interface MOD-03PolicyContext {
  user: {
    id: string;
    role: string;
    orgId: string;
    department?: string;
    mfaVerified: boolean;
    ip: string;
    country: string;
  };
  resource: {
    type: string;       // "entity" | "report" | "config"
    id: string;
    ownerId: string;
    orgId: string;
    visibility: "public" | "org" | "private";
    sensitivity: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "restricted";
    locked: boolean;
    status: string;
  };
  action: "read" | "create" | "update" | "delete" | "export" | "admin";
  environment: {
    time: string;          // ISO 8601
    dayOfWeek: number;     // 0-6
    isBusinessHours: boolean;
    sourceIp: string;
    isVpn: boolean;
  };
}

// Definicion de politicas ABAC para Authorization Engine
const MOD-03ABACpolicies: MOD-03Policy[] = [
  {
    id: "MOD-03-POL-001",
    name: "Acceso a recursos propios",
    effect: "allow",
    condition: (ctx) =>
      ctx.user.id === ctx.resource.ownerId &&
      ctx.action !== "delete" || ctx.user.role === "admin",
  },
  {
    id: "MOD-03-POL-002",
    name: "Restriccion de sensibilidad",
    effect: "deny",
    condition: (ctx) =>
      ctx.resource.sensitivity === "restricted" &&
      ctx.user.role !== "super_admin" &&
      !ctx.user.mfaVerified,
  },
  {
    id: "MOD-03-POL-003",
    name: "Bloqueo de recursos",
    effect: "deny",
    condition: (ctx) =>
      ctx.resource.locked &&
      ctx.user.role !== "super_admin",
  },
  {
    id: "MOD-03-POL-004",
    name: "Restriccion horaria para operaciones criticas",
    effect: "deny",
    condition: (ctx) =>
      (ctx.action === "delete" || ctx.action === "admin") &&
      !ctx.environment.isBusinessHours &&
      ctx.user.role !== "super_admin",
  },
  {
    id: "MOD-03-POL-005",
    name: "Acceso por visibilidad del recurso",
    effect: "allow",
    condition: (ctx) => {
      if (ctx.resource.visibility === "public") return true;
      if (ctx.resource.visibility === "org") return ctx.user.orgId === ctx.resource.orgId;
      return ctx.user.id === ctx.resource.ownerId;
    },
  },
];

```

#### Motor de Evaluacion de Permisos para MOD-03```typescript
// src/lib/auth/mod-03-permission-engine.ts

export class MOD-03PermissionEngine {
  private rolePermissions: Map<string, Set<string>>;
  private policies: MOD-03Policy[];
  private denyOverrides: Map<string, string[]>;

  constructor() {
    this.rolePermissions = new Map();
    this.policies = MOD-03ABACpolicies;
    this.denyOverrides = new Map([
      ["viewer", ["create", "update", "delete", "export", "admin", "bulk"]],
      ["guest", ["create", "update", "delete", "export", "admin", "bulk"]],
      ["editor", ["delete", "admin", "bulk"]],
      ["manager", ["delete", "admin"]],
    ]);
  }

  async check(context: MOD-03PolicyContext): Promise<{
    allowed: boolean;
    matchedPolicies: string[];
    deniedBy: string[];
  }> {
    const matchedPolicies: string[] = [];
    const deniedBy: string[] = [];

    // 1. Evaluar denegaciones explicitas por rol
    const roleDeny = this.denyOverrides.get(context.user.role) || [];
    if (roleDeny.includes(context.action)) {
      return {
        allowed: false,
        matchedPolicies,
        deniedBy: ["role_deny:" + context.action],
      };
    }

    // 2. Evaluar politicas ABAC (deny-first)
    for (const policy of this.policies) {
      if (policy.effect === "deny" && policy.condition(context)) {
        deniedBy.push(policy.id);
      }
      if (policy.condition(context)) {
        matchedPolicies.push(policy.id);
      }
    }

    if (deniedBy.length > 0) {
      return { allowed: false, matchedPolicies, deniedBy };
    }

    // 3. Evaluar permisos RBAC
    const permissions = this.rolePermissions.get(context.user.role);
    const hasPermission = permissions?.has(context.action) ?? false;

    // 4. Evaluar allow policies ABAC
    const hasAllowPolicy = this.policies.some(
      (p) => p.effect === "allow" && p.condition(context)
    );

    return {
      allowed: hasPermission || hasAllowPolicy,
      matchedPolicies,
      deniedBy,
    };
  }
}

```

### 4. MOD-04: Notification Service

Multi-channel notification dispatch with templating and preference management

#### Modelo RBAC Jerarquico para MOD-04El sistema de autorizacion del modulo Notification Service implementa un modelo RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) con jerarquia de roles y herencia de permisos. Cada rol hereda todos los permisos del rol inmediatamente inferior, con la capacidad de anadir permisos adicionales o denegaciones explicitas. La jerarquia sigue el principio de minimo privilegio.

| Nivel | Rol         | Permisos Heredados            | Permisos Adicionales                                   | Denegaciones                                | Usuarios Tipicos              |
| ----- | ----------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| L0    | super_admin | Todos los permisos de admin   | System config, user management, billing, audit access  | Ninguna                                     | CTO, VP Engineering           |
| L1    | admin       | Todos los permisos de manager | Delete any, bulk operations, module config, export all | No puede modificar system config            | Tech Lead, DevOps Lead        |
| L2    | manager     | Todos los permisos de editor  | Create/Update any in org, export org data, view audit  | No puede eliminar registros de otros        | Engineering Manager, PM       |
| L3    | editor      | Todos los permisos de viewer  | Create own, update own, export own data                | No puede ver registros privados de otros    | Senior Developer, Analyst     |
| L4    | viewer      | Permisos base de lectura      | Read public/org records, search, view metrics          | No puede escribir, exportar ni configurar   | Junior Developer, Stakeholder |
| L5    | guest       | Permiso minimo                | Read public records only                               | No puede acceder a datos de la organizacion | External collaborator         |
| L6    | api_service | Machine-to-machine            | Configurable scopes por API key                        | No puede acceder a UI features              | Service accounts, webhooks    |

#### Matriz de Permisos Detallada por Operacion para MOD-04| Operacion            | super_admin | admin | manager | editor          | viewer | guest | api_service         | MFA Req |
| -------------------- | ----------- | ----- | ------- | --------------- | ------ | ----- | ------------------- | ------- |
| GET /list (public)   | Allow       | Allow | Allow   | Allow           | Allow  | Allow | Allow (scope)       | No      |
| GET /list (org)      | Allow       | Allow | Allow   | Allow           | Allow  | Deny  | Allow (scope)       | No      |
| GET /:id (own)       | Allow       | Allow | Allow   | Allow           | Allow  | Deny  | Allow (scope)       | No      |
| GET /:id (other)     | Allow       | Allow | Allow   | Deny            | Deny   | Deny  | Deny                | No      |
| GET /:id (sensitive) | Allow       | Allow | Allow   | Deny (override) | Deny   | Deny  | Deny                | Si      |
| POST / (create)      | Allow       | Allow | Allow   | Allow (own)     | Deny   | Deny  | Allow (scope)       | Si      |
| PUT /:id (own)       | Allow       | Allow | Allow   | Allow           | Deny   | Deny  | Allow (scope)       | Si      |
| PUT /:id (other)     | Allow       | Allow | Deny    | Deny            | Deny   | Deny  | Deny                | Si      |
| DELETE /:id          | Allow       | Allow | Deny    | Deny            | Deny   | Deny  | Allow (admin scope) | Si      |

| POST /export         | Allow       | Allow | Allow   | Allow (own)     | Deny   | Deny  | Allow (scope)       | Si      |
| GET /audit-log       | Allow       | Allow | Allow   | Deny            | Deny   | Deny  | Deny                | Si      |
| PUT /config          | Allow       | Allow | Deny    | Deny            | Deny   | Deny  | Deny                | Si      |

#### Politicas ABAC (Attribute-Based Access Control) para MOD-04Ademas del RBAC jerarquico, el modulo Notification Service soporta politicas ABAC que evaluan atributos contextuales en tiempo de decision. Las politicas ABAC complementan al RBAC permitiendo reglas mas granulares basadas en atributos del recurso, del usuario, del entorno y de la accion.

```typescript
// src/lib/auth/mod-04-abac.policy.ts

interface MOD-04PolicyContext {
  user: {
    id: string;
    role: string;
    orgId: string;
    department?: string;
    mfaVerified: boolean;
    ip: string;
    country: string;
  };
  resource: {
    type: string;       // "entity" | "report" | "config"
    id: string;
    ownerId: string;
    orgId: string;
    visibility: "public" | "org" | "private";
    sensitivity: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "restricted";
    locked: boolean;
    status: string;
  };
  action: "read" | "create" | "update" | "delete" | "export" | "admin";
  environment: {
    time: string;          // ISO 8601
    dayOfWeek: number;     // 0-6
    isBusinessHours: boolean;
    sourceIp: string;
    isVpn: boolean;
  };
}

// Definicion de politicas ABAC para Notification Service
const MOD-04ABACpolicies: MOD-04Policy[] = [
  {
    id: "MOD-04-POL-001",
    name: "Acceso a recursos propios",
    effect: "allow",
    condition: (ctx) =>
      ctx.user.id === ctx.resource.ownerId &&
      ctx.action !== "delete" || ctx.user.role === "admin",
  },
  {
    id: "MOD-04-POL-002",
    name: "Restriccion de sensibilidad",
    effect: "deny",
    condition: (ctx) =>
      ctx.resource.sensitivity === "restricted" &&
      ctx.user.role !== "super_admin" &&
      !ctx.user.mfaVerified,
  },
  {
    id: "MOD-04-POL-003",
    name: "Bloqueo de recursos",
    effect: "deny",
    condition: (ctx) =>
      ctx.resource.locked &&
      ctx.user.role !== "super_admin",
  },
  {
    id: "MOD-04-POL-004",
    name: "Restriccion horaria para operaciones criticas",
    effect: "deny",
    condition: (ctx) =>
      (ctx.action === "delete" || ctx.action === "admin") &&
      !ctx.environment.isBusinessHours &&
      ctx.user.role !== "super_admin",
  },
  {
    id: "MOD-04-POL-005",
    name: "Acceso por visibilidad del recurso",
    effect: "allow",
    condition: (ctx) => {
      if (ctx.resource.visibility === "public") return true;
      if (ctx.resource.visibility === "org") return ctx.user.orgId === ctx.resource.orgId;
      return ctx.user.id === ctx.resource.ownerId;
    },
  },
];

```

#### Motor de Evaluacion de Permisos para MOD-04```typescript
// src/lib/auth/mod-04-permission-engine.ts

export class MOD-04PermissionEngine {
  private rolePermissions: Map<string, Set<string>>;
  private policies: MOD-04Policy[];
  private denyOverrides: Map<string, string[]>;

  constructor() {
    this.rolePermissions = new Map();
    this.policies = MOD-04ABACpolicies;
    this.denyOverrides = new Map([
      ["viewer", ["create", "update", "delete", "export", "admin", "bulk"]],
      ["guest", ["create", "update", "delete", "export", "admin", "bulk"]],
      ["editor", ["delete", "admin", "bulk"]],
      ["manager", ["delete", "admin"]],
    ]);
  }

  async check(context: MOD-04PolicyContext): Promise<{
    allowed: boolean;
    matchedPolicies: string[];
    deniedBy: string[];
  }> {
    const matchedPolicies: string[] = [];
    const deniedBy: string[] = [];

    // 1. Evaluar denegaciones explicitas por rol
    const roleDeny = this.denyOverrides.get(context.user.role) || [];
    if (roleDeny.includes(context.action)) {
      return {
        allowed: false,
        matchedPolicies,
        deniedBy: ["role_deny:" + context.action],
      };
    }

    // 2. Evaluar politicas ABAC (deny-first)
    for (const policy of this.policies) {
      if (policy.effect === "deny" && policy.condition(context)) {
        deniedBy.push(policy.id);
      }
      if (policy.condition(context)) {
        matchedPolicies.push(policy.id);
      }
    }

    if (deniedBy.length > 0) {
      return { allowed: false, matchedPolicies, deniedBy };
    }

    // 3. Evaluar permisos RBAC
    const permissions = this.rolePermissions.get(context.user.role);
    const hasPermission = permissions?.has(context.action) ?? false;

    // 4. Evaluar allow policies ABAC
    const hasAllowPolicy = this.policies.some(
      (p) => p.effect === "allow" && p.condition(context)
    );

    return {
      allowed: hasPermission || hasAllowPolicy,
      matchedPolicies,
      deniedBy,
    };
  }
}

```

### 5. MOD-05: Search & Discovery Module

Full-text search, faceted filtering, and content recommendation

#### Modelo RBAC Jerarquico para MOD-05El sistema de autorizacion del modulo Search & Discovery Module implementa un modelo RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) con jerarquia de roles y herencia de permisos. Cada rol hereda todos los permisos del rol inmediatamente inferior, con la capacidad de anadir permisos adicionales o denegaciones explicitas. La jerarquia sigue el principio de minimo privilegio.

| Nivel | Rol         | Permisos Heredados            | Permisos Adicionales                                   | Denegaciones                                | Usuarios Tipicos              |
| ----- | ----------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| L0    | super_admin | Todos los permisos de admin   | System config, user management, billing, audit access  | Ninguna                                     | CTO, VP Engineering           |
| L1    | admin       | Todos los permisos de manager | Delete any, bulk operations, module config, export all | No puede modificar system config            | Tech Lead, DevOps Lead        |
| L2    | manager     | Todos los permisos de editor  | Create/Update any in org, export org data, view audit  | No puede eliminar registros de otros        | Engineering Manager, PM       |
| L3    | editor      | Todos los permisos de viewer  | Create own, update own, export own data                | No puede ver registros privados de otros    | Senior Developer, Analyst     |
| L4    | viewer      | Permisos base de lectura      | Read public/org records, search, view metrics          | No puede escribir, exportar ni configurar   | Junior Developer, Stakeholder |
| L5    | guest       | Permiso minimo                | Read public records only                               | No puede acceder a datos de la organizacion | External collaborator         |
| L6    | api_service | Machine-to-machine            | Configurable scopes por API key                        | No puede acceder a UI features              | Service accounts, webhooks    |

#### Politicas ABAC (Attribute-Based Access Control) para MOD-05Ademas del RBAC jerarquico, el modulo Search & Discovery Module soporta politicas ABAC que evaluan atributos contextuales en tiempo de decision. Las politicas ABAC complementan al RBAC permitiendo reglas mas granulares basadas en atributos del recurso, del usuario, del entorno y de la accion.

```typescript
// src/lib/auth/mod-05-abac.policy.ts

interface MOD-05PolicyContext {
  user: {
    id: string;
    role: string;
    orgId: string;
    department?: string;
    mfaVerified: boolean;
    ip: string;
    country: string;
  };
  resource: {
    type: string;       // "entity" | "report" | "config"
    id: string;
    ownerId: string;
    orgId: string;
    visibility: "public" | "org" | "private";
    sensitivity: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "restricted";
    locked: boolean;
    status: string;
  };
  action: "read" | "create" | "update" | "delete" | "export" | "admin";
  environment: {
    time: string;          // ISO 8601
    dayOfWeek: number;     // 0-6
    isBusinessHours: boolean;
    sourceIp: string;
    isVpn: boolean;
  };
}

// Definicion de politicas ABAC para Search & Discovery Module
const MOD-05ABACpolicies: MOD-05Policy[] = [
  {
    id: "MOD-05-POL-001",
    name: "Acceso a recursos propios",
    effect: "allow",
    condition: (ctx) =>
      ctx.user.id === ctx.resource.ownerId &&
      ctx.action !== "delete" || ctx.user.role === "admin",
  },
  {
    id: "MOD-05-POL-002",
    name: "Restriccion de sensibilidad",
    effect: "deny",
    condition: (ctx) =>
      ctx.resource.sensitivity === "restricted" &&
      ctx.user.role !== "super_admin" &&
      !ctx.user.mfaVerified,
  },
  {
    id: "MOD-05-POL-003",
    name: "Bloqueo de recursos",
    effect: "deny",
    condition: (ctx) =>
      ctx.resource.locked &&
      ctx.user.role !== "super_admin",
  },
  {
    id: "MOD-05-POL-004",
    name: "Restriccion horaria para operaciones criticas",
    effect: "deny",
    condition: (ctx) =>
      (ctx.action === "delete" || ctx.action === "admin") &&
      !ctx.environment.isBusinessHours &&
      ctx.user.role !== "super_admin",
  },
  {
    id: "MOD-05-POL-005",
    name: "Acceso por visibilidad del recurso",
    effect: "allow",
    condition: (ctx) => {
      if (ctx.resource.visibility === "public") return true;
      if (ctx.resource.visibility === "org") return ctx.user.orgId === ctx.resource.orgId;
      return ctx.user.id === ctx.resource.ownerId;
    },
  },
];

```

#### Motor de Evaluacion de Permisos para MOD-05```typescript
// src/lib/auth/mod-05-permission-engine.ts

export class MOD-05PermissionEngine {
  private rolePermissions: Map<string, Set<string>>;
  private policies: MOD-05Policy[];
  private denyOverrides: Map<string, string[]>;

  constructor() {
    this.rolePermissions = new Map();
    this.policies = MOD-05ABACpolicies;
    this.denyOverrides = new Map([
      ["viewer", ["create", "update", "delete", "export", "admin", "bulk"]],
      ["guest", ["create", "update", "delete", "export", "admin", "bulk"]],
      ["editor", ["delete", "admin", "bulk"]],
      ["manager", ["delete", "admin"]],
    ]);
  }

  async check(context: MOD-05PolicyContext): Promise<{
    allowed: boolean;
    matchedPolicies: string[];
    deniedBy: string[];
  }> {
    const matchedPolicies: string[] = [];
    const deniedBy: string[] = [];

    // 1. Evaluar denegaciones explicitas por rol
    const roleDeny = this.denyOverrides.get(context.user.role) || [];
    if (roleDeny.includes(context.action)) {
      return {
        allowed: false,
        matchedPolicies,
        deniedBy: ["role_deny:" + context.action],
      };
    }

    // 2. Evaluar politicas ABAC (deny-first)
    for (const policy of this.policies) {
      if (policy.effect === "deny" && policy.condition(context)) {
        deniedBy.push(policy.id);
      }
      if (policy.condition(context)) {
        matchedPolicies.push(policy.id);
      }
    }

    if (deniedBy.length > 0) {
      return { allowed: false, matchedPolicies, deniedBy };
    }

    // 3. Evaluar permisos RBAC
    const permissions = this.rolePermissions.get(context.user.role);
    const hasPermission = permissions?.has(context.action) ?? false;

    // 4. Evaluar allow policies ABAC
    const hasAllowPolicy = this.policies.some(
      (p) => p.effect === "allow" && p.condition(context)
    );

    return {
      allowed: hasPermission || hasAllowPolicy,
      matchedPolicies,
      deniedBy,
    };
  }
}

```

    name: "Bloqueo de recursos",
    effect: "deny",
    condition: (ctx) =>
      ctx.resource.locked &&
      ctx.user.role !== "super_admin",
  },
  {
    id: "MOD-06-POL-004",
    name: "Restriccion horaria para operaciones criticas",
    effect: "deny",
    condition: (ctx) =>
      (ctx.action === "delete" || ctx.action === "admin") &&
      !ctx.environment.isBusinessHours &&
      ctx.user.role !== "super_admin",
  },
  {
    id: "MOD-06-POL-005",
    name: "Acceso por visibilidad del recurso",
    effect: "allow",
    condition: (ctx) => {
      if (ctx.resource.visibility === "public") return true;
      if (ctx.resource.visibility === "org") return ctx.user.orgId === ctx.resource.orgId;
      return ctx.user.id === ctx.resource.ownerId;
    },
  },
];

```

#### Motor de Evaluacion de Permisos para MOD-06```typescript
// src/lib/auth/mod-06-permission-engine.ts

export class MOD-06PermissionEngine {
  private rolePermissions: Map<string, Set<string>>;
  private policies: MOD-06Policy[];
  private denyOverrides: Map<string, string[]>;

  constructor() {
    this.rolePermissions = new Map();
    this.policies = MOD-06ABACpolicies;
    this.denyOverrides = new Map([
      ["viewer", ["create", "update", "delete", "export", "admin", "bulk"]],
      ["guest", ["create", "update", "delete", "export", "admin", "bulk"]],
      ["editor", ["delete", "admin", "bulk"]],
      ["manager", ["delete", "admin"]],
    ]);
  }

  async check(context: MOD-06PolicyContext): Promise<{
    allowed: boolean;
    matchedPolicies: string[];
    deniedBy: string[];
  }> {
    const matchedPolicies: string[] = [];
    const deniedBy: string[] = [];

    // 1. Evaluar denegaciones explicitas por rol
    const roleDeny = this.denyOverrides.get(context.user.role) || [];
    if (roleDeny.includes(context.action)) {
      return {
        allowed: false,
        matchedPolicies,
        deniedBy: ["role_deny:" + context.action],
      };
    }

    // 2. Evaluar politicas ABAC (deny-first)
    for (const policy of this.policies) {
      if (policy.effect === "deny" && policy.condition(context)) {
        deniedBy.push(policy.id);
      }
      if (policy.condition(context)) {
        matchedPolicies.push(policy.id);
      }
    }

    if (deniedBy.length > 0) {
      return { allowed: false, matchedPolicies, deniedBy };
    }

    // 3. Evaluar permisos RBAC
    const permissions = this.rolePermissions.get(context.user.role);
    const hasPermission = permissions?.has(context.action) ?? false;

    // 4. Evaluar allow policies ABAC
    const hasAllowPolicy = this.policies.some(
      (p) => p.effect === "allow" && p.condition(context)
    );

    return {
      allowed: hasPermission || hasAllowPolicy,
      matchedPolicies,
      deniedBy,
    };
  }
}

```

## Seguridad — Threat Model y Criptografia Avanzada — Detalle por Modulo

Las siguientes subsecciones proporcionan especificaciones detalladas para cada modulo funcional del sistema en el contexto de seguridad — threat model y criptografia avanzada. Cada modulo incluye tablas de requisitos, matrices de trazabilidad, especificaciones tecnicas y criterios de aceptacion.

### 1. MOD-01: Core Application Service

Central orchestration of business logic and workflow coordination

#### Matriz de Amenazas Avanzada para MOD-01El analisis de amenazas del modulo Core Application Service sigue la metodologia STRIDE per-componente, complementada con el MITRE ATT&CK framework para mapeo tactico. Cada amenaza se evalua segun probabilidad, impacto y controles existentes vs requeridos.

#### Especificacion de Encriptacion para MOD-01La estrategia de encriptacion del modulo Core Application Service implementa defensa en profundidad con capas de proteccion en reposo, en transito, en uso (via HSM) y en procesamiento. Se sigue el principio de encriptacion por defecto para todos los datos clasificados como sensibles.

| Capa                 | Algoritmo         | Longitud Clave      | Modo                | IV/Nonce                 | Key Derivation     | Rotacion             | HSM                  |
| -------------------- | ----------------- | ------------------- | ------------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------ | -------------------- | -------------------- |
| En reposo (DB)       | AES-256-GCM       | 256 bits            | GCM (authenticated) | Random 96-bit per record | HKDF-SHA256        | Cada 90 dias         | Opcional (Cloud KMS) |
| En reposo (archivos) | AES-256-GCM       | 256 bits            | GCM                 | Random 96-bit per file   | HKDF-SHA256        | Cada 90 dias         | Recomendado          |
| En transito (API)    | TLS 1.3           | ECDHE (X25519)      | AEAD                | Implicit                 | ECDHE key exchange | Certificado: 90 dias | N/A                  |
| En transito (DB)     | TLS 1.3           | ECDHE (X25519)      | AEAD                | Implicit                 | ECDHE key exchange | Certificado: 90 dias | N/A                  |
| JWT signing          | RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 | RSA 2048-bit        | RS256               | N/A                      | RSA key pair       | Anual                | Recomendado          |
| Password hashing     | bcrypt            | Cost 12 (4096 iter) | N/A                 | Salt: 128-bit random     | N/A (one-way)      | En cambio de pwd     | N/A                  |
| API Key signing      | HMAC-SHA256       | 256 bits            | N/A                 | Timestamp + nonce        | HKDF               | Cada 180 dias        | Opcional             |
| PII tokenization     | AES-256-GCM       | 256 bits            | GCM                 | Random per field         | HKDF-SHA256        | Cada 90 dias         | Recomendado          |
| Sensitive config     | ChaCha20-Poly1305 | 256 bits            | AEAD                | Random 96-bit            | Argon2id           | Cada 30 dias         | Obligatorio          |

};

### 2. MOD-02: Authentication Module

User identity management, session handling, token lifecycle, and MFA support

#### Matriz de Amenazas Avanzada para MOD-02El analisis de amenazas del modulo Authentication Module sigue la metodologia STRIDE per-componente, complementada con el MITRE ATT&CK framework para mapeo tactico. Cada amenaza se evalua segun probabilidad, impacto y controles existentes vs requeridos.

| ID           | STRIDE Cat.     | Amenaza                                  | Componente          | MITRE Tactic                  | Prob. | Impacto | Controles Actuales     | Controles Requeridos              | Gap     |
| ------------ | --------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------------------- | ----------------------------- | ----- | ------- | ---------------------- | --------------------------------- | ------- |
| MOD-02-T-001 | Spoofing        | Credential stuffing automatizado         | Auth Endpoint       | TA0001 (Initial Access)       | Alta  | Critico | Rate limiting, lockout | CAPTCHA, device fingerprint       | Parcial |
| MOD-02-T-002 | Tampering       | Modificacion de datos en transito (MITM) | API Gateway         | TA0009 (Collection)           | Media | Critico | TLS 1.3                | Certificate pinning, HSTS preload | Parcial |
| MOD-02-T-003 | Repudiation     | Borrado de logs de auditoria             | Audit Logger        | TA0005 (Defense Evasion)      | Baja  | Alto    | Append-only audit DB   | WORM storage, hash chain          | Parcial |
| MOD-02-T-004 | Info Disclosure | Exfiltracion de datos PII via API        | API Responses       | TA0010 (Exfiltration)         | Media | Critico | Field masking, RBAC    | DLP, anomaly detection            | Parcial |
| MOD-02-T-005 | DoS             | Resource exhaustion via large payloads   | File Upload         | TA0040 (Impact)               | Alta  | Alto    | Payload size limit     | Adaptive throttling, WAF          | Si      |
| MOD-02-T-006 | EoP             | IDOR en endpoints de detalle             | Controller          | TA0004 (Privilege Escalation) | Media | Critico | Ownership checks       | Automated IDOR testing            | Parcial |
| MOD-02-T-007 | Spoofing        | Token JWT forjado o alterado             | Auth Middleware     | TA0001                        | Baja  | Critico | RS256 signature        | Key rotation, JWK endpoint        | No      |
| MOD-02-T-008 | Info Disclosure | Path traversal en descarga de archivos   | Storage Service     | TA0009                        | Media | Alto    | Input sanitization     | Chroot jail, allowlist            | Parcial |
| MOD-02-T-009 | Tampering       | Supply chain attack en dependencias      | Build Pipeline      | TA0003 (Persistence)          | Baja  | Critico | npm audit              | Lockfile integrity, SCA           | Parcial |
| MOD-02-T-010 | EoP             | SSRF via webhook URLs                    | Integration Adapter | TA0008 (Execution)            | Media | Critico | URL validation         | Allowlist, metadata detection     | Si      |

#### Especificacion de Encriptacion para MOD-02La estrategia de encriptacion del modulo Authentication Module implementa defensa en profundidad con capas de proteccion en reposo, en transito, en uso (via HSM) y en procesamiento. Se sigue el principio de encriptacion por defecto para todos los datos clasificados como sensibles.

| Capa                 | Algoritmo         | Longitud Clave      | Modo                | IV/Nonce                 | Key Derivation     | Rotacion             | HSM                  |
| -------------------- | ----------------- | ------------------- | ------------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------ | -------------------- | -------------------- |
| En reposo (DB)       | AES-256-GCM       | 256 bits            | GCM (authenticated) | Random 96-bit per record | HKDF-SHA256        | Cada 90 dias         | Opcional (Cloud KMS) |
| En reposo (archivos) | AES-256-GCM       | 256 bits            | GCM                 | Random 96-bit per file   | HKDF-SHA256        | Cada 90 dias         | Recomendado          |
| En transito (API)    | TLS 1.3           | ECDHE (X25519)      | AEAD                | Implicit                 | ECDHE key exchange | Certificado: 90 dias | N/A                  |
| En transito (DB)     | TLS 1.3           | ECDHE (X25519)      | AEAD                | Implicit                 | ECDHE key exchange | Certificado: 90 dias | N/A                  |
| JWT signing          | RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 | RSA 2048-bit        | RS256               | N/A                      | RSA key pair       | Anual                | Recomendado          |
| Password hashing     | bcrypt            | Cost 12 (4096 iter) | N/A                 | Salt: 128-bit random     | N/A (one-way)      | En cambio de pwd     | N/A                  |
| API Key signing      | HMAC-SHA256       | 256 bits            | N/A                 | Timestamp + nonce        | HKDF               | Cada 180 dias        | Opcional             |
| PII tokenization     | AES-256-GCM       | 256 bits            | GCM                 | Random per field         | HKDF-SHA256        | Cada 90 dias         | Recomendado          |
| Sensitive config     | ChaCha20-Poly1305 | 256 bits            | AEAD                | Random 96-bit            | Argon2id           | Cada 30 dias         | Obligatorio          |

#### Key Management para MOD-02```typescript
// src/lib/security/mod-02-key-management.ts

export const MOD-02KeyManagementConfig = {
  provider: process.env.KMS_PROVIDER || "aws-kms", // aws-kms | gcp-kms | azure-keyvault | vault
  masterKey: {
    id: process.env.KMS_MASTER_KEY_ID || "alias/mod-02-master-key",
    rotation: "90d",
    backupEnabled: true,
    deletionProtection: true,
  },
  dataKeys: {
    cache: {
      maxSize: 1000,
      ttl: 3600, // 1 hora
    },
    rotationSchedule: "90d",
    encryptionContext: {
      module: "Authentication Module",
      environment: process.env.NODE_ENV,
    },
  },
  envelopeEncryption: {
    enabled: true,
    aadPrefix: "mod-02:",
    keyLength: 256,
  },
  secrets: {
    store: "vault", // vault | aws-secrets | gcp-secret
    rotation: {
      enabled: true,
      schedule: "30d",
      autoRotate: true,
    },
    accessLog: {
      enabled: true,
      destination: "audit-db",
    },
  },
};

```

#### Especificacion de Encriptacion para MOD-03La estrategia de encriptacion del modulo Authorization Engine implementa defensa en profundidad con capas de proteccion en reposo, en transito, en uso (via HSM) y en procesamiento. Se sigue el principio de encriptacion por defecto para todos los datos clasificados como sensibles.

| Capa                 | Algoritmo         | Longitud Clave      | Modo                | IV/Nonce                 | Key Derivation     | Rotacion             | HSM                  |
| -------------------- | ----------------- | ------------------- | ------------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------ | -------------------- | -------------------- |
| En reposo (DB)       | AES-256-GCM       | 256 bits            | GCM (authenticated) | Random 96-bit per record | HKDF-SHA256        | Cada 90 dias         | Opcional (Cloud KMS) |
| En reposo (archivos) | AES-256-GCM       | 256 bits            | GCM                 | Random 96-bit per file   | HKDF-SHA256        | Cada 90 dias         | Recomendado          |
| En transito (API)    | TLS 1.3           | ECDHE (X25519)      | AEAD                | Implicit                 | ECDHE key exchange | Certificado: 90 dias | N/A                  |
| En transito (DB)     | TLS 1.3           | ECDHE (X25519)      | AEAD                | Implicit                 | ECDHE key exchange | Certificado: 90 dias | N/A                  |
| JWT signing          | RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 | RSA 2048-bit        | RS256               | N/A                      | RSA key pair       | Anual                | Recomendado          |
| Password hashing     | bcrypt            | Cost 12 (4096 iter) | N/A                 | Salt: 128-bit random     | N/A (one-way)      | En cambio de pwd     | N/A                  |
| API Key signing      | HMAC-SHA256       | 256 bits            | N/A                 | Timestamp + nonce        | HKDF               | Cada 180 dias        | Opcional             |
| PII tokenization     | AES-256-GCM       | 256 bits            | GCM                 | Random per field         | HKDF-SHA256        | Cada 90 dias         | Recomendado          |
| Sensitive config     | ChaCha20-Poly1305 | 256 bits            | AEAD                | Random 96-bit            | Argon2id           | Cada 30 dias         | Obligatorio          |

#### Key Management para MOD-03```typescript
// src/lib/security/mod-03-key-management.ts

export const MOD-03KeyManagementConfig = {
  provider: process.env.KMS_PROVIDER || "aws-kms", // aws-kms | gcp-kms | azure-keyvault | vault
  masterKey: {
    id: process.env.KMS_MASTER_KEY_ID || "alias/mod-03-master-key",
    rotation: "90d",
    backupEnabled: true,
    deletionProtection: true,
  },
  dataKeys: {
    cache: {
      maxSize: 1000,
      ttl: 3600, // 1 hora
    },
    rotationSchedule: "90d",
    encryptionContext: {
      module: "Authorization Engine",
      environment: process.env.NODE_ENV,
    },
  },
  envelopeEncryption: {
    enabled: true,
    aadPrefix: "mod-03:",
    keyLength: 256,
  },
  secrets: {
    store: "vault", // vault | aws-secrets | gcp-secret
    rotation: {
      enabled: true,
      schedule: "30d",
      autoRotate: true,
    },
    accessLog: {
      enabled: true,
      destination: "audit-db",
    },
  },
};

```

### 4. MOD-04: Notification Service

Multi-channel notification dispatch with templating and preference management

#### Matriz de Amenazas Avanzada para MOD-04El analisis de amenazas del modulo Notification Service sigue la metodologia STRIDE per-componente, complementada con el MITRE ATT&CK framework para mapeo tactico. Cada amenaza se evalua segun probabilidad, impacto y controles existentes vs requeridos.

| ID           | STRIDE Cat.     | Amenaza                                  | Componente          | MITRE Tactic                  | Prob. | Impacto | Controles Actuales     | Controles Requeridos              | Gap     |
| ------------ | --------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------------------- | ----------------------------- | ----- | ------- | ---------------------- | --------------------------------- | ------- |
| MOD-04-T-001 | Spoofing        | Credential stuffing automatizado         | Auth Endpoint       | TA0001 (Initial Access)       | Alta  | Critico | Rate limiting, lockout | CAPTCHA, device fingerprint       | Parcial |
| MOD-04-T-002 | Tampering       | Modificacion de datos en transito (MITM) | API Gateway         | TA0009 (Collection)           | Media | Critico | TLS 1.3                | Certificate pinning, HSTS preload | Parcial |
| MOD-04-T-003 | Repudiation     | Borrado de logs de auditoria             | Audit Logger        | TA0005 (Defense Evasion)      | Baja  | Alto    | Append-only audit DB   | WORM storage, hash chain          | Parcial |
| MOD-04-T-004 | Info Disclosure | Exfiltracion de datos PII via API        | API Responses       | TA0010 (Exfiltration)         | Media | Critico | Field masking, RBAC    | DLP, anomaly detection            | Parcial |
| MOD-04-T-005 | DoS             | Resource exhaustion via large payloads   | File Upload         | TA0040 (Impact)               | Alta  | Alto    | Payload size limit     | Adaptive throttling, WAF          | Si      |
| MOD-04-T-006 | EoP             | IDOR en endpoints de detalle             | Controller          | TA0004 (Privilege Escalation) | Media | Critico | Ownership checks       | Automated IDOR testing            | Parcial |
| MOD-04-T-007 | Spoofing        | Token JWT forjado o alterado             | Auth Middleware     | TA0001                        | Baja  | Critico | RS256 signature        | Key rotation, JWK endpoint        | No      |
| MOD-04-T-008 | Info Disclosure | Path traversal en descarga de archivos   | Storage Service     | TA0009                        | Media | Alto    | Input sanitization     | Chroot jail, allowlist            | Parcial |
| MOD-04-T-009 | Tampering       | Supply chain attack en dependencias      | Build Pipeline      | TA0003 (Persistence)          | Baja  | Critico | npm audit              | Lockfile integrity, SCA           | Parcial |
| MOD-04-T-010 | EoP             | SSRF via webhook URLs                    | Integration Adapter | TA0008 (Execution)            | Media | Critico | URL validation         | Allowlist, metadata detection     | Si      |

### 5. MOD-05: Search & Discovery Module

Full-text search, faceted filtering, and content recommendation

#### Matriz de Amenazas Avanzada para MOD-05El analisis de amenazas del modulo Search & Discovery Module sigue la metodologia STRIDE per-componente, complementada con el MITRE ATT&CK framework para mapeo tactico. Cada amenaza se evalua segun probabilidad, impacto y controles existentes vs requeridos.

| ID           | STRIDE Cat.     | Amenaza                                  | Componente          | MITRE Tactic                  | Prob. | Impacto | Controles Actuales     | Controles Requeridos              | Gap     |
| ------------ | --------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------------------- | ----------------------------- | ----- | ------- | ---------------------- | --------------------------------- | ------- |
| MOD-05-T-001 | Spoofing        | Credential stuffing automatizado         | Auth Endpoint       | TA0001 (Initial Access)       | Alta  | Critico | Rate limiting, lockout | CAPTCHA, device fingerprint       | Parcial |
| MOD-05-T-002 | Tampering       | Modificacion de datos en transito (MITM) | API Gateway         | TA0009 (Collection)           | Media | Critico | TLS 1.3                | Certificate pinning, HSTS preload | Parcial |
| MOD-05-T-003 | Repudiation     | Borrado de logs de auditoria             | Audit Logger        | TA0005 (Defense Evasion)      | Baja  | Alto    | Append-only audit DB   | WORM storage, hash chain          | Parcial |
| MOD-05-T-004 | Info Disclosure | Exfiltracion de datos PII via API        | API Responses       | TA0010 (Exfiltration)         | Media | Critico | Field masking, RBAC    | DLP, anomaly detection            | Parcial |
| MOD-05-T-005 | DoS             | Resource exhaustion via large payloads   | File Upload         | TA0040 (Impact)               | Alta  | Alto    | Payload size limit     | Adaptive throttling, WAF          | Si      |
| MOD-05-T-006 | EoP             | IDOR en endpoints de detalle             | Controller          | TA0004 (Privilege Escalation) | Media | Critico | Ownership checks       | Automated IDOR testing            | Parcial |
| MOD-05-T-007 | Spoofing        | Token JWT forjado o alterado             | Auth Middleware     | TA0001                        | Baja  | Critico | RS256 signature        | Key rotation, JWK endpoint        | No      |
| MOD-05-T-008 | Info Disclosure | Path traversal en descarga de archivos   | Storage Service     | TA0009                        | Media | Alto    | Input sanitization     | Chroot jail, allowlist            | Parcial |
| MOD-05-T-009 | Tampering       | Supply chain attack en dependencias      | Build Pipeline      | TA0003 (Persistence)          | Baja  | Critico | npm audit              | Lockfile integrity, SCA           | Parcial |
| MOD-05-T-010 | EoP             | SSRF via webhook URLs                    | Integration Adapter | TA0008 (Execution)            | Media | Critico | URL validation         | Allowlist, metadata detection     | Si      |

#### Especificacion de Encriptacion para MOD-05La estrategia de encriptacion del modulo Search & Discovery Module implementa defensa en profundidad con capas de proteccion en reposo, en transito, en uso (via HSM) y en procesamiento. Se sigue el principio de encriptacion por defecto para todos los datos clasificados como sensibles.

| Capa                 | Algoritmo         | Longitud Clave      | Modo                | IV/Nonce                 | Key Derivation     | Rotacion             | HSM                  |
| -------------------- | ----------------- | ------------------- | ------------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------ | -------------------- | -------------------- |
| En reposo (DB)       | AES-256-GCM       | 256 bits            | GCM (authenticated) | Random 96-bit per record | HKDF-SHA256        | Cada 90 dias         | Opcional (Cloud KMS) |
| En reposo (archivos) | AES-256-GCM       | 256 bits            | GCM                 | Random 96-bit per file   | HKDF-SHA256        | Cada 90 dias         | Recomendado          |
| En transito (API)    | TLS 1.3           | ECDHE (X25519)      | AEAD                | Implicit                 | ECDHE key exchange | Certificado: 90 dias | N/A                  |
| En transito (DB)     | TLS 1.3           | ECDHE (X25519)      | AEAD                | Implicit                 | ECDHE key exchange | Certificado: 90 dias | N/A                  |
| JWT signing          | RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 | RSA 2048-bit        | RS256               | N/A                      | RSA key pair       | Anual                | Recomendado          |
| Password hashing     | bcrypt            | Cost 12 (4096 iter) | N/A                 | Salt: 128-bit random     | N/A (one-way)      | En cambio de pwd     | N/A                  |
| API Key signing      | HMAC-SHA256       | 256 bits            | N/A                 | Timestamp + nonce        | HKDF               | Cada 180 dias        | Opcional             |
| PII tokenization     | AES-256-GCM       | 256 bits            | GCM                 | Random per field         | HKDF-SHA256        | Cada 90 dias         | Recomendado          |
| Sensitive config     | ChaCha20-Poly1305 | 256 bits            | AEAD                | Random 96-bit            | Argon2id           | Cada 30 dias         | Obligatorio          |

#### Key Management para MOD-05```typescript
// src/lib/security/mod-05-key-management.ts

export const MOD-05KeyManagementConfig = {
  provider: process.env.KMS_PROVIDER || "aws-kms", // aws-kms | gcp-kms | azure-keyvault | vault
  masterKey: {
    id: process.env.KMS_MASTER_KEY_ID || "alias/mod-05-master-key",
    rotation: "90d",
    backupEnabled: true,
    deletionProtection: true,
  },
  dataKeys: {
    cache: {
      maxSize: 1000,
      ttl: 3600, // 1 hora
    },
    rotationSchedule: "90d",
    encryptionContext: {
      module: "Search & Discovery Module",
      environment: process.env.NODE_ENV,
    },
  },
  envelopeEncryption: {
    enabled: true,
    aadPrefix: "mod-05:",
    keyLength: 256,
  },
  secrets: {
    store: "vault", // vault | aws-secrets | gcp-secret
    rotation: {
      enabled: true,
      schedule: "30d",
      autoRotate: true,
    },
    accessLog: {
      enabled: true,
      destination: "audit-db",
    },
  },
};

```

#### Matriz de Amenazas Avanzada para MOD-06El analisis de amenazas del modulo Analytics Engine sigue la metodologia STRIDE per-componente, complementada con el MITRE ATT&CK framework para mapeo tactico. Cada amenaza se evalua segun probabilidad, impacto y controles existentes vs requeridos.

#### Especificacion de Encriptacion para MOD-06La estrategia de encriptacion del modulo Analytics Engine implementa defensa en profundidad con capas de proteccion en reposo, en transito, en uso (via HSM) y en procesamiento. Se sigue el principio de encriptacion por defecto para todos los datos clasificados como sensibles.

| Capa                 | Algoritmo         | Longitud Clave      | Modo                | IV/Nonce                 | Key Derivation     | Rotacion             | HSM                  |
| -------------------- | ----------------- | ------------------- | ------------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------ | -------------------- | -------------------- |
| En reposo (DB)       | AES-256-GCM       | 256 bits            | GCM (authenticated) | Random 96-bit per record | HKDF-SHA256        | Cada 90 dias         | Opcional (Cloud KMS) |
| En reposo (archivos) | AES-256-GCM       | 256 bits            | GCM                 | Random 96-bit per file   | HKDF-SHA256        | Cada 90 dias         | Recomendado          |
| En transito (API)    | TLS 1.3           | ECDHE (X25519)      | AEAD                | Implicit                 | ECDHE key exchange | Certificado: 90 dias | N/A                  |
| En transito (DB)     | TLS 1.3           | ECDHE (X25519)      | AEAD                | Implicit                 | ECDHE key exchange | Certificado: 90 dias | N/A                  |
| JWT signing          | RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 | RSA 2048-bit        | RS256               | N/A                      | RSA key pair       | Anual                | Recomendado          |
| Password hashing     | bcrypt            | Cost 12 (4096 iter) | N/A                 | Salt: 128-bit random     | N/A (one-way)      | En cambio de pwd     | N/A                  |
| API Key signing      | HMAC-SHA256       | 256 bits            | N/A                 | Timestamp + nonce        | HKDF               | Cada 180 dias        | Opcional             |
| PII tokenization     | AES-256-GCM       | 256 bits            | GCM                 | Random per field         | HKDF-SHA256        | Cada 90 dias         | Recomendado          |
| Sensitive config     | ChaCha20-Poly1305 | 256 bits            | AEAD                | Random 96-bit            | Argon2id           | Cada 30 dias         | Obligatorio          |

#### Key Management para MOD-06```typescript
// src/lib/security/mod-06-key-management.ts

export const MOD-06KeyManagementConfig = {
  provider: process.env.KMS_PROVIDER || "aws-kms", // aws-kms | gcp-kms | azure-keyvault | vault
  masterKey: {
    id: process.env.KMS_MASTER_KEY_ID || "alias/mod-06-master-key",
    rotation: "90d",
    backupEnabled: true,
    deletionProtection: true,
  },
  dataKeys: {
    cache: {
      maxSize: 1000,
      ttl: 3600, // 1 hora
    },
    rotationSchedule: "90d",
    encryptionContext: {
      module: "Analytics Engine",
      environment: process.env.NODE_ENV,
    },
  },
  envelopeEncryption: {
    enabled: true,
    aadPrefix: "mod-06:",
    keyLength: 256,
  },
  secrets: {
    store: "vault", // vault | aws-secrets | gcp-secret
    rotation: {
      enabled: true,
      schedule: "30d",
      autoRotate: true,
    },
    accessLog: {
      enabled: true,
      destination: "audit-db",
    },
  },
};

```

## Logging — Configuracion Estructurada Avanzada — Detalle por Modulo

Las siguientes subsecciones proporcionan especificaciones detalladas para cada modulo funcional del sistema en el contexto de logging — configuracion estructurada avanzada. Cada modulo incluye tablas de requisitos, matrices de trazabilidad, especificaciones tecnicas y criterios de aceptacion.

### 1. MOD-01: Core Application Service

Central orchestration of business logic and workflow coordination

#### Arquitectura de Logging para MOD-01El sistema de logging del modulo Core Application Service implementa una arquitectura distribuida con tres capas: produccion (agent), agregacion (collector) y analisis (storage + query). Se utiliza el formato estructurado JSON con campos normalizados para permitir busqueda eficiente y analisis automatizado.

```text
  Arquitectura de Logging — Modulo Core Application Service

  [App Instance]         [Log Aggregator]        [Storage]            [Analysis]
  ┌──────────────┐       ┌──────────────┐       ┌──────────────┐     ┌────────────┐
  │ Structured   │──────>│ Vector/Fluent│──────>│ Elasticsearch│────>│ Grafana    │
  │ JSON Logger  │ TCP   │ Bit          │ HTTP  │ Cluster (30d) │     │ Loki       │
  │ (pino/winston)│      │              │       │              │     │            │
  └──────────────┘       └──────┬───────┘       └──────┬───────┘     └────────────┘
                                │                      │
                         ┌──────▼───────┐       ┌──────▼───────┐     ┌────────────┐
                         │ Kafka Buffer │       │ S3 Cold      │────>│ PagerDuty  │
                         │ (backlog)    │       │ Storage (1y) │     │ Slack Alert│
                         └──────────────┘       └──────────────┘     └────────────┘

```

#### Configuracion de Logger Estructurado para MOD-01```typescript
// src/lib/logging/mod-01-logger.ts

import pino from "pino";

export const MOD-01Logger = pino({
  name: "Core Application Service",
  level: process.env.LOG_LEVEL || "info",
  base: {
    service: "SW-AOE",
    module: "Core Application Service",
    version: process.env.APP_VERSION || "1.0.0",
    environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || "development",
  },
  redact: {
    paths: [
      "req.headers.authorization",
      "req.headers.cookie",
      "req.body.password",
      "req.body.token",
      "req.body.creditCard",
      "req.body.ssn",
      "res.body.accessToken",
      "res.body.refreshToken",
      "user.email",
      "user.phone",
      "dbQuery",
    ],
    censor: "[REDACTED]",
  },
  timestamp: pino.stdTimeFunctions.isoTime,
  formatters: {
    level(label) { return { level: label }; },
    log(object) {
      if (object.err) {
        object.error = {
          name: object.err.name,
          message: object.err.message,
          stack: object.err.stack,
          code: object.err.code,
        };
        delete object.err;
      }
      return object;
    },
  },
  serializers: {
    req(req) {
      return {
        method: req.method,
        url: req.url,
        headers: {
          "user-agent": req.headers["user-agent"],
          "x-request-id": req.headers["x-request-id"],
          "x-forwarded-for": req.headers["x-forwarded-for"],
        },
        remoteAddress: req.remoteAddress,
      };
    },
    res(res) {
      return {
        statusCode: res.statusCode,
      };
    },
  },
  transport: process.env.NODE_ENV === "development"
    ? { target: "pino-pretty", options: { colorize: true, translateTime: "SYS:standard" } }
    : undefined,
});

```
