#### Patrones de Logging por Capa para MOD-01| Capa            | Eventos Logueados                 | Nivel Minimo | Datos Capturados                       | Sampling            | Structured Fields           | Performance Impact |
| --------------- | --------------------------------- | ------------ | -------------------------------------- | ------------------- | --------------------------- | ------------------ |
| API Gateway     | Requests, responses, errors       | INFO         | method, path, status, duration, IP, UA | 100% (all requests) | requestId, traceId, spanId  | < 1ms overhead     |
| Auth Middleware | Auth success/failure, MFA         | WARN         | userId, method, reason, IP, device     | 100%                | sessionId, authMethod       | < 0.5ms            |
| Controller      | Input validation, business errors | INFO         | endpoint, dto errors, userId           | 100%                | requestId, validationErrors | < 0.5ms            |
| Service         | Business logic events, decisions  | INFO         | operation, entityId, result, duration  | 100%                | traceId, operationType      | < 1ms              |
| Repository      | DB queries (slow only)            | WARN         | query hash, duration, table, rows      | 10% (sampling)      | queryHash, dbSystem         | < 0.5ms            |
| Cache Manager   | Cache hits/misses, evictions      | DEBUG        | cacheKey, hit/miss, ttl, operation     | 1% (sampling)       | cacheSystem, cacheKey       | < 0.1ms            |
| Event Bus       | Events published/consumed         | INFO         | eventType, eventId, status, duration   | 100%                | eventId, aggregateId        | < 1ms              |
| Queue Worker    | Job start/complete/fail, retry    | INFO         | jobId, jobType, status, progress       | 100%                | jobId, attempt, queueName   | < 1ms              |

### 2. MOD-02: Authentication Module

User identity management, session handling, token lifecycle, and MFA support

#### Arquitectura de Logging para MOD-02El sistema de logging del modulo Authentication Module implementa una arquitectura distribuida con tres capas: produccion (agent), agregacion (collector) y analisis (storage + query). Se utiliza el formato estructurado JSON con campos normalizados para permitir busqueda eficiente y analisis automatizado.

```text
  Arquitectura de Logging — Modulo Authentication Module

  [App Instance]         [Log Aggregator]        [Storage]            [Analysis]
  ┌──────────────┐       ┌──────────────┐       ┌──────────────┐     ┌────────────┐
  │ Structured   │──────>│ Vector/Fluent│──────>│ Elasticsearch│────>│ Grafana    │
  │ JSON Logger  │ TCP   │ Bit          │ HTTP  │ Cluster (30d) │     │ Loki       │
  │ (pino/winston)│      │              │       │              │     │            │
  └──────────────┘       └──────┬───────┘       └──────┬───────┘     └────────────┘
                                │                      │
                         ┌──────▼───────┐       ┌──────▼───────┐     ┌────────────┐
                         │ Kafka Buffer │       │ S3 Cold      │────>│ PagerDuty  │
                         │ (backlog)    │       │ Storage (1y) │     │ Slack Alert│
                         └──────────────┘       └──────────────┘     └────────────┘

```

#### Configuracion de Logger Estructurado para MOD-02```typescript
// src/lib/logging/mod-02-logger.ts

import pino from "pino";

export const MOD-02Logger = pino({
  name: "Authentication Module",
  level: process.env.LOG_LEVEL || "info",
  base: {
    service: "SW-AOE",
    module: "Authentication Module",
    version: process.env.APP_VERSION || "1.0.0",
    environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || "development",
  },
  redact: {
    paths: [
      "req.headers.authorization",
      "req.headers.cookie",
      "req.body.password",
      "req.body.token",
      "req.body.creditCard",
      "req.body.ssn",
      "res.body.accessToken",
      "res.body.refreshToken",
      "user.email",
      "user.phone",
      "dbQuery",
    ],
    censor: "[REDACTED]",
  },
  timestamp: pino.stdTimeFunctions.isoTime,
  formatters: {
    level(label) { return { level: label }; },
    log(object) {
      if (object.err) {
        object.error = {
          name: object.err.name,
          message: object.err.message,
          stack: object.err.stack,
          code: object.err.code,
        };
        delete object.err;
      }
      return object;
    },
  },
  serializers: {
    req(req) {
      return {
        method: req.method,
        url: req.url,
        headers: {
          "user-agent": req.headers["user-agent"],
          "x-request-id": req.headers["x-request-id"],
          "x-forwarded-for": req.headers["x-forwarded-for"],
        },
        remoteAddress: req.remoteAddress,
      };
    },
    res(res) {
      return {
        statusCode: res.statusCode,
      };
    },
  },
  transport: process.env.NODE_ENV === "development"
    ? { target: "pino-pretty", options: { colorize: true, translateTime: "SYS:standard" } }
    : undefined,
});

```

#### Log Shipping y Retencion para MOD-02| Nivel Log | Destino Primario                  | Destino Secundario    | Retencion Caliente | Retencion Fria | Compresion | Indexado               | Costo Estimado |
| --------- | --------------------------------- | --------------------- | ------------------ | -------------- | ---------- | ---------------------- | -------------- |
| DEBUG     | N/A (solo desarrollo)             | N/A                   | N/A                | N/A            | N/A        | N/A                    | $0             |
| INFO      | Elasticsearch                     | S3 Glacier            | 30 dias            | 1 ano          | LZ4        | Full-text              | $50/mes        |
| WARN      | Elasticsearch                     | S3 Standard           | 90 dias            | 2 anos         | LZ4        | Full-text + metrics    | $100/mes       |
| ERROR     | Elasticsearch + PagerDuty         | S3 Standard           | 90 dias            | 7 anos         | GZIP       | Full-text + alerts     | $150/mes       |
| FATAL     | Elasticsearch + PagerDuty + Slack | S3 Standard + Glacier | 365 dias           | Indefinido     | GZIP       | Full-text + compliance | $200/mes       |

#### Patrones de Logging por Capa para MOD-02| Capa            | Eventos Logueados                 | Nivel Minimo | Datos Capturados                       | Sampling            | Structured Fields           | Performance Impact |
| --------------- | --------------------------------- | ------------ | -------------------------------------- | ------------------- | --------------------------- | ------------------ |
| API Gateway     | Requests, responses, errors       | INFO         | method, path, status, duration, IP, UA | 100% (all requests) | requestId, traceId, spanId  | < 1ms overhead     |
| Auth Middleware | Auth success/failure, MFA         | WARN         | userId, method, reason, IP, device     | 100%                | sessionId, authMethod       | < 0.5ms            |
| Controller      | Input validation, business errors | INFO         | endpoint, dto errors, userId           | 100%                | requestId, validationErrors | < 0.5ms            |
| Service         | Business logic events, decisions  | INFO         | operation, entityId, result, duration  | 100%                | traceId, operationType      | < 1ms              |
| Repository      | DB queries (slow only)            | WARN         | query hash, duration, table, rows      | 10% (sampling)      | queryHash, dbSystem         | < 0.5ms            |
| Cache Manager   | Cache hits/misses, evictions      | DEBUG        | cacheKey, hit/miss, ttl, operation     | 1% (sampling)       | cacheSystem, cacheKey       | < 0.1ms            |
| Event Bus       | Events published/consumed         | INFO         | eventType, eventId, status, duration   | 100%                | eventId, aggregateId        | < 1ms              |
| Queue Worker    | Job start/complete/fail, retry    | INFO         | jobId, jobType, status, progress       | 100%                | jobId, attempt, queueName   | < 1ms              |

#### Alerting sobre Logs para MOD-02| ID Alerta          | Patron de Log           | Condicion                              | Severidad | Canal                    | Accion Automatica         | False Positive Rate |
| ------------------ | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------- | --------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------- | ------------------- |
| MOD-02-LOG-ALT-001 | ERROR level spikes      | > 10 errores/min durante 5 min         | P1        | PagerDuty + Slack        | Auto-scale + diagnostics  | < 5%                |
| MOD-02-LOG-ALT-002 | Auth failure pattern    | > 5 fallos de auth/min desde misma IP  | P2        | Slack + Email            | IP ban temporal (1h)      | < 10%               |
| MOD-02-LOG-ALT-003 | FATAL application crash | Cualquier log FATAL                    | P0        | PagerDuty (call) + Slack | Auto-restart + core dump  | < 1%                |
| MOD-02-LOG-ALT-004 | Slow query increase     | > 20 queries lentas/min                | P2        | Slack                    | DB connection pool review | < 15%               |
| MOD-02-LOG-ALT-005 | Rate limit breach       | > 100 requests/s desde mismo token     | P2        | Slack                    | Token temporal revoke     | < 5%                |
| MOD-02-LOG-ALT-006 | Anomalia de patron      | Desviacion > 3 sigma de volumen normal | P3        | Slack                    | Captura de snapshot       | < 20%               |

### 4. MOD-04: Notification Service

Multi-channel notification dispatch with templating and preference management

#### Arquitectura de Logging para MOD-04El sistema de logging del modulo Notification Service implementa una arquitectura distribuida con tres capas: produccion (agent), agregacion (collector) y analisis (storage + query). Se utiliza el formato estructurado JSON con campos normalizados para permitir busqueda eficiente y analisis automatizado.

```text
  Arquitectura de Logging — Modulo Notification Service

  [App Instance]         [Log Aggregator]        [Storage]            [Analysis]
  ┌──────────────┐       ┌──────────────┐       ┌──────────────┐     ┌────────────┐
  │ Structured   │──────>│ Vector/Fluent│──────>│ Elasticsearch│────>│ Grafana    │
  │ JSON Logger  │ TCP   │ Bit          │ HTTP  │ Cluster (30d) │     │ Loki       │
  │ (pino/winston)│      │              │       │              │     │            │
  └──────────────┘       └──────┬───────┘       └──────┬───────┘     └────────────┘
                                │                      │
                         ┌──────▼───────┐       ┌──────▼───────┐     ┌────────────┐
                         │ Kafka Buffer │       │ S3 Cold      │────>│ PagerDuty  │
                         │ (backlog)    │       │ Storage (1y) │     │ Slack Alert│
                         └──────────────┘       └──────────────┘     └────────────┘

```

#### Configuracion de Logger Estructurado para MOD-04```typescript
// src/lib/logging/mod-04-logger.ts

import pino from "pino";

export const MOD-04Logger = pino({
  name: "Notification Service",
  level: process.env.LOG_LEVEL || "info",
  base: {
    service: "SW-AOE",
    module: "Notification Service",
    version: process.env.APP_VERSION || "1.0.0",
    environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || "development",
  },
  redact: {
    paths: [
      "req.headers.authorization",
      "req.headers.cookie",
      "req.body.password",
      "req.body.token",
      "req.body.creditCard",
      "req.body.ssn",
      "res.body.accessToken",
      "res.body.refreshToken",
      "user.email",
      "user.phone",
      "dbQuery",
    ],
    censor: "[REDACTED]",
  },
  timestamp: pino.stdTimeFunctions.isoTime,
  formatters: {
    level(label) { return { level: label }; },
    log(object) {
      if (object.err) {
        object.error = {
          name: object.err.name,
          message: object.err.message,
          stack: object.err.stack,
          code: object.err.code,
        };
        delete object.err;
      }
      return object;
    },
  },
  serializers: {
    req(req) {
      return {
        method: req.method,
        url: req.url,
        headers: {
          "user-agent": req.headers["user-agent"],
          "x-request-id": req.headers["x-request-id"],
          "x-forwarded-for": req.headers["x-forwarded-for"],
        },
        remoteAddress: req.remoteAddress,
      };
    },
    res(res) {
      return {
        statusCode: res.statusCode,
      };
    },
  },
  transport: process.env.NODE_ENV === "development"
    ? { target: "pino-pretty", options: { colorize: true, translateTime: "SYS:standard" } }
    : undefined,
});

```

#### Log Shipping y Retencion para MOD-04| Nivel Log | Destino Primario                  | Destino Secundario    | Retencion Caliente | Retencion Fria | Compresion | Indexado               | Costo Estimado |
| --------- | --------------------------------- | --------------------- | ------------------ | -------------- | ---------- | ---------------------- | -------------- |
| DEBUG     | N/A (solo desarrollo)             | N/A                   | N/A                | N/A            | N/A        | N/A                    | $0             |
| INFO      | Elasticsearch                     | S3 Glacier            | 30 dias            | 1 ano          | LZ4        | Full-text              | $50/mes        |
| WARN      | Elasticsearch                     | S3 Standard           | 90 dias            | 2 anos         | LZ4        | Full-text + metrics    | $100/mes       |
| ERROR     | Elasticsearch + PagerDuty         | S3 Standard           | 90 dias            | 7 anos         | GZIP       | Full-text + alerts     | $150/mes       |
| FATAL     | Elasticsearch + PagerDuty + Slack | S3 Standard + Glacier | 365 dias           | Indefinido     | GZIP       | Full-text + compliance | $200/mes       |

#### Patrones de Logging por Capa para MOD-04| Capa            | Eventos Logueados                 | Nivel Minimo | Datos Capturados                       | Sampling            | Structured Fields           | Performance Impact |
| --------------- | --------------------------------- | ------------ | -------------------------------------- | ------------------- | --------------------------- | ------------------ |
| API Gateway     | Requests, responses, errors       | INFO         | method, path, status, duration, IP, UA | 100% (all requests) | requestId, traceId, spanId  | < 1ms overhead     |
| Auth Middleware | Auth success/failure, MFA         | WARN         | userId, method, reason, IP, device     | 100%                | sessionId, authMethod       | < 0.5ms            |
| Controller      | Input validation, business errors | INFO         | endpoint, dto errors, userId           | 100%                | requestId, validationErrors | < 0.5ms            |
| Service         | Business logic events, decisions  | INFO         | operation, entityId, result, duration  | 100%                | traceId, operationType      | < 1ms              |
| Repository      | DB queries (slow only)            | WARN         | query hash, duration, table, rows      | 10% (sampling)      | queryHash, dbSystem         | < 0.5ms            |
| Cache Manager   | Cache hits/misses, evictions      | DEBUG        | cacheKey, hit/miss, ttl, operation     | 1% (sampling)       | cacheSystem, cacheKey       | < 0.1ms            |
| Event Bus       | Events published/consumed         | INFO         | eventType, eventId, status, duration   | 100%                | eventId, aggregateId        | < 1ms              |
| Queue Worker    | Job start/complete/fail, retry    | INFO         | jobId, jobType, status, progress       | 100%                | jobId, attempt, queueName   | < 1ms              |

#### Alerting sobre Logs para MOD-04| ID Alerta          | Patron de Log           | Condicion                              | Severidad | Canal                    | Accion Automatica         | False Positive Rate |
| ------------------ | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------- | --------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------- | ------------------- |
| MOD-04-LOG-ALT-001 | ERROR level spikes      | > 10 errores/min durante 5 min         | P1        | PagerDuty + Slack        | Auto-scale + diagnostics  | < 5%                |
| MOD-04-LOG-ALT-002 | Auth failure pattern    | > 5 fallos de auth/min desde misma IP  | P2        | Slack + Email            | IP ban temporal (1h)      | < 10%               |
| MOD-04-LOG-ALT-003 | FATAL application crash | Cualquier log FATAL                    | P0        | PagerDuty (call) + Slack | Auto-restart + core dump  | < 1%                |
| MOD-04-LOG-ALT-004 | Slow query increase     | > 20 queries lentas/min                | P2        | Slack                    | DB connection pool review | < 15%               |
| MOD-04-LOG-ALT-005 | Rate limit breach       | > 100 requests/s desde mismo token     | P2        | Slack                    | Token temporal revoke     | < 5%                |
| MOD-04-LOG-ALT-006 | Anomalia de patron      | Desviacion > 3 sigma de volumen normal | P3        | Slack                    | Captura de snapshot       | < 20%               |

### 6. MOD-06: Analytics Engine

Event tracking, metric aggregation, custom dashboards, and data export

#### Arquitectura de Logging para MOD-06El sistema de logging del modulo Analytics Engine implementa una arquitectura distribuida con tres capas: produccion (agent), agregacion (collector) y analisis (storage + query). Se utiliza el formato estructurado JSON con campos normalizados para permitir busqueda eficiente y analisis automatizado.

```text
  Arquitectura de Logging — Modulo Analytics Engine

  [App Instance]         [Log Aggregator]        [Storage]            [Analysis]
  ┌──────────────┐       ┌──────────────┐       ┌──────────────┐     ┌────────────┐
  │ Structured   │──────>│ Vector/Fluent│──────>│ Elasticsearch│────>│ Grafana    │
  │ JSON Logger  │ TCP   │ Bit          │ HTTP  │ Cluster (30d) │     │ Loki       │
  │ (pino/winston)│      │              │       │              │     │            │
  └──────────────┘       └──────┬───────┘       └──────┬───────┘     └────────────┘
                                │                      │
                         ┌──────▼───────┐       ┌──────▼───────┐     ┌────────────┐
                         │ Kafka Buffer │       │ S3 Cold      │────>│ PagerDuty  │
                         │ (backlog)    │       │ Storage (1y) │     │ Slack Alert│
                         └──────────────┘       └──────────────┘     └────────────┘

```

#### Configuracion de Logger Estructurado para MOD-06```typescript
// src/lib/logging/mod-06-logger.ts

import pino from "pino";

export const MOD-06Logger = pino({
  name: "Analytics Engine",
  level: process.env.LOG_LEVEL || "info",
  base: {
    service: "SW-AOE",
    module: "Analytics Engine",
    version: process.env.APP_VERSION || "1.0.0",
    environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || "development",
  },
  redact: {
    paths: [
      "req.headers.authorization",
      "req.headers.cookie",
      "req.body.password",
      "req.body.token",
      "req.body.creditCard",
      "req.body.ssn",
      "res.body.accessToken",
      "res.body.refreshToken",
      "user.email",
      "user.phone",
      "dbQuery",
    ],
    censor: "[REDACTED]",
  },
  timestamp: pino.stdTimeFunctions.isoTime,
  formatters: {
    level(label) { return { level: label }; },
    log(object) {
      if (object.err) {
        object.error = {
          name: object.err.name,
          message: object.err.message,
          stack: object.err.stack,
          code: object.err.code,
        };
        delete object.err;
      }
      return object;
    },
  },
  serializers: {
    req(req) {
      return {
        method: req.method,
        url: req.url,
        headers: {
          "user-agent": req.headers["user-agent"],
          "x-request-id": req.headers["x-request-id"],
          "x-forwarded-for": req.headers["x-forwarded-for"],
        },
        remoteAddress: req.remoteAddress,
      };
    },
    res(res) {
      return {
        statusCode: res.statusCode,
      };
    },
  },
  transport: process.env.NODE_ENV === "development"
    ? { target: "pino-pretty", options: { colorize: true, translateTime: "SYS:standard" } }
    : undefined,
});

```

#### Log Shipping y Retencion para MOD-06| Nivel Log | Destino Primario                  | Destino Secundario    | Retencion Caliente | Retencion Fria | Compresion | Indexado               | Costo Estimado |
| --------- | --------------------------------- | --------------------- | ------------------ | -------------- | ---------- | ---------------------- | -------------- |
| DEBUG     | N/A (solo desarrollo)             | N/A                   | N/A                | N/A            | N/A        | N/A                    | $0             |
| INFO      | Elasticsearch                     | S3 Glacier            | 30 dias            | 1 ano          | LZ4        | Full-text              | $50/mes        |
| WARN      | Elasticsearch                     | S3 Standard           | 90 dias            | 2 anos         | LZ4        | Full-text + metrics    | $100/mes       |
| ERROR     | Elasticsearch + PagerDuty         | S3 Standard           | 90 dias            | 7 anos         | GZIP       | Full-text + alerts     | $150/mes       |
| FATAL     | Elasticsearch + PagerDuty + Slack | S3 Standard + Glacier | 365 dias           | Indefinido     | GZIP       | Full-text + compliance | $200/mes       |

#### Patrones de Logging por Capa para MOD-06| Capa            | Eventos Logueados                 | Nivel Minimo | Datos Capturados                       | Sampling            | Structured Fields           | Performance Impact |
| --------------- | --------------------------------- | ------------ | -------------------------------------- | ------------------- | --------------------------- | ------------------ |
| API Gateway     | Requests, responses, errors       | INFO         | method, path, status, duration, IP, UA | 100% (all requests) | requestId, traceId, spanId  | < 1ms overhead     |
| Auth Middleware | Auth success/failure, MFA         | WARN         | userId, method, reason, IP, device     | 100%                | sessionId, authMethod       | < 0.5ms            |
| Controller      | Input validation, business errors | INFO         | endpoint, dto errors, userId           | 100%                | requestId, validationErrors | < 0.5ms            |
| Service         | Business logic events, decisions  | INFO         | operation, entityId, result, duration  | 100%                | traceId, operationType      | < 1ms              |
| Repository      | DB queries (slow only)            | WARN         | query hash, duration, table, rows      | 10% (sampling)      | queryHash, dbSystem         | < 0.5ms            |
| Cache Manager   | Cache hits/misses, evictions      | DEBUG        | cacheKey, hit/miss, ttl, operation     | 1% (sampling)       | cacheSystem, cacheKey       | < 0.1ms            |
| Event Bus       | Events published/consumed         | INFO         | eventType, eventId, status, duration   | 100%                | eventId, aggregateId        | < 1ms              |
| Queue Worker    | Job start/complete/fail, retry    | INFO         | jobId, jobType, status, progress       | 100%                | jobId, attempt, queueName   | < 1ms              |

## Monitoreo — Dashboards Prometheus/Grafana — Detalle por Modulo

Las siguientes subsecciones proporcionan especificaciones detalladas para cada modulo funcional del sistema en el contexto de monitoreo — dashboards prometheus/grafana. Cada modulo incluye tablas de requisitos, matrices de trazabilidad, especificaciones tecnicas y criterios de aceptacion.

### 1. MOD-01: Core Application Service

Central orchestration of business logic and workflow coordination

#### Configuracion de Metricas Prometheus para MOD-01```yaml
# prometheus/rules/mod-01-alerts.yml
groups:
  - name: MOD-01_alerts
    rules:
      - alert: MOD-01HighErrorRate
        expr: |
          (
            sum(rate(http_requests_total{module="Core Application Service",status=~"5.."}[5m]))
            /
            sum(rate(http_requests_total{module="Core Application Service"}[5m]))
          ) > 0.05
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: critical
          team: backend
        annotations:
          summary: "Tasa de error alta en Core Application Service"
          description: "Error rate de {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} supera 5%"
          runbook: "https://wiki.internal/runbooks/MOD-01-001"

      - alert: MOD-01HighLatencyP95
        expr: |
          histogram_quantile(0.95,
            sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{module="Core Application Service"}[5m])) by (le)
          ) > 0.5
        for: 10m
        labels:
          severity: warning
          team: backend
        annotations:
          summary: "Latencia p95 alta en Core Application Service"
          description: "p95 = {{ $value }}s (target: < 0.2s)"
          runbook: "https://wiki.internal/runbooks/MOD-01-002"

      - alert: MOD-01ServiceDown
        expr: up{job="core application service"} == 0
        for: 2m
        labels:
          severity: critical
          team: devops
        annotations:
          summary: "Core Application Service no responde"
          description: "El modulo lleva 2 minutos sin responder"
          runbook: "https://wiki.internal/runbooks/MOD-01-005"

```

#### Instrumentacion OpenTelemetry para MOD-01```typescript
// src/lib/telemetry/mod-01-instrumentation.ts

import { trace, metrics, UpDownCounter, Histogram, Counter } from "@opentelemetry/api";
import { Resource } from "@opentelemetry/resources";
import { SemanticResourceAttributes } from "@opentelemetry/semantic-conventions";

const tracer = trace.getTracer("SW-AOE-core application service", "1.0.0");
const meter = metrics.getMeter("SW-AOE-core application service", "1.0.0");

// Contadores
export const MOD-01RequestCounter: Counter = meter.createCounter(
  "mod-01_requests_total",
  { description: "Total de requests del modulo Core Application Service" }
);

export const MOD-01ErrorCounter: Counter = meter.createCounter(
  "mod-01_errors_total",
  { description: "Total de errores del modulo Core Application Service" }
);

export const MOD-01ActiveUsers: UpDownCounter = meter.createUpDownCounter(
  "mod-01_active_users",
  { description: "Usuarios activos actuales en Core Application Service" }
);

// Histogramas
export const MOD-01RequestDuration: Histogram = meter.createHistogram(
  "mod-01_request_duration_seconds",
  {
    description: "Duracion de requests del modulo Core Application Service",
    advice: { explicitBucketBoundaries: [0.01, 0.025, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2.5, 5, 10] },
  }
);

export const MOD-01DBQueryDuration: Histogram = meter.createHistogram(
  "mod-01_db_query_duration_seconds",
  {
    description: "Duracion de queries DB del modulo Core Application Service",
    advice: { explicitBucketBoundaries: [0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.025, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1] },
  }
);

```

#### Mapeo de Metricas RED y USE para MOD-01| Metodo          | Metrica        | Tipo      | PromQL                                                                     | Significado                          | Accion sobre Threshold             |
| --------------- | -------------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------- |
| R - Rate        | Requests/sec   | Counter   | rate(mod-01_requests_total[1m])                                            | Volumen de trafico entrante          | Scale up si > capacidad * 0.8      |
| E - Errors      | Error rate %   | Counter   | rate(mod-01_errors_total[1m]) / rate(mod-01_requests_total[1m])            | Proporcion de requests fallidos      | Alerta si > 1%, investigar si > 5% |
| D - Duration    | Latencia p95   | Histogram | histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(mod-01_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) | Tiempo de respuesta del percentil 95 | Investigar si > target             |
| U - Utilization | CPU %          | Gauge     | process_cpu_usage{module="Core Application Service"}                       | Uso de CPU del proceso               | Scale up si > 70%                  |
| U - Utilization | Memory %       | Gauge     | process_resident_memory_bytes / process_resident_memory_limit              | Uso de memoria                       | Investigar leak si crece lineal    |
| U - Utilization | DB Connections | Gauge     | pg_stat_database.numbackends                                               | Conexiones activas a PostgreSQL      | Pool expansion si > 80%            |
| U - Saturation  | Request Queue  | Gauge     | process_http_requests_active                                               | Requests en procesamiento            | Scale up si > max_concurrent * 0.9 |
| U - Saturation  | DB Locks       | Gauge     | pg_locks.count{mode="exclusive"}                                           | Locks exclusivos activos             | Investigar deadlocks si > 5        |

### 2. MOD-02: Authentication Module

User identity management, session handling, token lifecycle, and MFA support

#### Configuracion de Metricas Prometheus para MOD-02```yaml
# prometheus/rules/mod-02-alerts.yml
groups:
  - name: MOD-02_alerts
    rules:
      - alert: MOD-02HighErrorRate
        expr: |
          (
            sum(rate(http_requests_total{module="Authentication Module",status=~"5.."}[5m]))
            /
            sum(rate(http_requests_total{module="Authentication Module"}[5m]))
          ) > 0.05
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: critical
          team: backend
        annotations:
          summary: "Tasa de error alta en Authentication Module"
          description: "Error rate de {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} supera 5%"
          runbook: "https://wiki.internal/runbooks/MOD-02-001"

      - alert: MOD-02HighLatencyP95
        expr: |
          histogram_quantile(0.95,
            sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{module="Authentication Module"}[5m])) by (le)
          ) > 0.5
        for: 10m
        labels:
          severity: warning
          team: backend
        annotations:
          summary: "Latencia p95 alta en Authentication Module"
          description: "p95 = {{ $value }}s (target: < 0.2s)"
          runbook: "https://wiki.internal/runbooks/MOD-02-002"

      - alert: MOD-02ServiceDown
        expr: up{job="authentication module"} == 0
        for: 2m
        labels:
          severity: critical
          team: devops
        annotations:
          summary: "Authentication Module no responde"
          description: "El modulo lleva 2 minutos sin responder"
          runbook: "https://wiki.internal/runbooks/MOD-02-005"

```

#### Instrumentacion OpenTelemetry para MOD-02```typescript
// src/lib/telemetry/mod-02-instrumentation.ts

import { trace, metrics, UpDownCounter, Histogram, Counter } from "@opentelemetry/api";
import { Resource } from "@opentelemetry/resources";
import { SemanticResourceAttributes } from "@opentelemetry/semantic-conventions";

const tracer = trace.getTracer("SW-AOE-authentication module", "1.0.0");
const meter = metrics.getMeter("SW-AOE-authentication module", "1.0.0");

// Contadores
export const MOD-02RequestCounter: Counter = meter.createCounter(
  "mod-02_requests_total",
  { description: "Total de requests del modulo Authentication Module" }
);

export const MOD-02ErrorCounter: Counter = meter.createCounter(
  "mod-02_errors_total",
  { description: "Total de errores del modulo Authentication Module" }
);

export const MOD-02ActiveUsers: UpDownCounter = meter.createUpDownCounter(
  "mod-02_active_users",
  { description: "Usuarios activos actuales en Authentication Module" }
);

// Histogramas
export const MOD-02RequestDuration: Histogram = meter.createHistogram(
  "mod-02_request_duration_seconds",
  {
    description: "Duracion de requests del modulo Authentication Module",
    advice: { explicitBucketBoundaries: [0.01, 0.025, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2.5, 5, 10] },
  }
);

export const MOD-02DBQueryDuration: Histogram = meter.createHistogram(
  "mod-02_db_query_duration_seconds",
  {
    description: "Duracion de queries DB del modulo Authentication Module",
    advice: { explicitBucketBoundaries: [0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.025, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1] },
  }
);

```

#### Mapeo de Metricas RED y USE para MOD-02| Metodo          | Metrica        | Tipo      | PromQL                                                                     | Significado                          | Accion sobre Threshold             |
| --------------- | -------------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------- |
| R - Rate        | Requests/sec   | Counter   | rate(mod-02_requests_total[1m])                                            | Volumen de trafico entrante          | Scale up si > capacidad * 0.8      |

| U - Utilization | Memory %       | Gauge     | process_resident_memory_bytes / process_resident_memory_limit              | Uso de memoria                       | Investigar leak si crece lineal    |
| U - Utilization | DB Connections | Gauge     | pg_stat_database.numbackends                                               | Conexiones activas a PostgreSQL      | Pool expansion si > 80%            |
| U - Saturation  | Request Queue  | Gauge     | process_http_requests_active                                               | Requests en procesamiento            | Scale up si > max_concurrent * 0.9 |
| U - Saturation  | DB Locks       | Gauge     | pg_locks.count{mode="exclusive"}                                           | Locks exclusivos activos             | Investigar deadlocks si > 5        |

### 4. MOD-04: Notification Service

Multi-channel notification dispatch with templating and preference management

#### Configuracion de Metricas Prometheus para MOD-04```yaml
# prometheus/rules/mod-04-alerts.yml
groups:
  - name: MOD-04_alerts
    rules:
      - alert: MOD-04HighErrorRate
        expr: |
          (
            sum(rate(http_requests_total{module="Notification Service",status=~"5.."}[5m]))
            /
            sum(rate(http_requests_total{module="Notification Service"}[5m]))
          ) > 0.05
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: critical
          team: backend
        annotations:
          summary: "Tasa de error alta en Notification Service"
          description: "Error rate de {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} supera 5%"
          runbook: "https://wiki.internal/runbooks/MOD-04-001"

      - alert: MOD-04HighLatencyP95
        expr: |
          histogram_quantile(0.95,
            sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{module="Notification Service"}[5m])) by (le)
          ) > 0.5
        for: 10m
        labels:
          severity: warning
          team: backend
        annotations:
          summary: "Latencia p95 alta en Notification Service"
          description: "p95 = {{ $value }}s (target: < 0.2s)"
          runbook: "https://wiki.internal/runbooks/MOD-04-002"

      - alert: MOD-04ServiceDown
        expr: up{job="notification service"} == 0
        for: 2m
        labels:
          severity: critical
          team: devops
        annotations:
          summary: "Notification Service no responde"
          description: "El modulo lleva 2 minutos sin responder"
          runbook: "https://wiki.internal/runbooks/MOD-04-005"

```

#### Instrumentacion OpenTelemetry para MOD-04```typescript
// src/lib/telemetry/mod-04-instrumentation.ts

import { trace, metrics, UpDownCounter, Histogram, Counter } from "@opentelemetry/api";
import { Resource } from "@opentelemetry/resources";
import { SemanticResourceAttributes } from "@opentelemetry/semantic-conventions";

const tracer = trace.getTracer("SW-AOE-notification service", "1.0.0");
const meter = metrics.getMeter("SW-AOE-notification service", "1.0.0");

// Contadores
export const MOD-04RequestCounter: Counter = meter.createCounter(
  "mod-04_requests_total",
  { description: "Total de requests del modulo Notification Service" }
);

export const MOD-04ErrorCounter: Counter = meter.createCounter(
  "mod-04_errors_total",
  { description: "Total de errores del modulo Notification Service" }
);

export const MOD-04ActiveUsers: UpDownCounter = meter.createUpDownCounter(
  "mod-04_active_users",
  { description: "Usuarios activos actuales en Notification Service" }
);

// Histogramas
export const MOD-04RequestDuration: Histogram = meter.createHistogram(
  "mod-04_request_duration_seconds",
  {
    description: "Duracion de requests del modulo Notification Service",
    advice: { explicitBucketBoundaries: [0.01, 0.025, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2.5, 5, 10] },
  }
);

export const MOD-04DBQueryDuration: Histogram = meter.createHistogram(
  "mod-04_db_query_duration_seconds",
  {
    description: "Duracion de queries DB del modulo Notification Service",
    advice: { explicitBucketBoundaries: [0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.025, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1] },
  }
);

```

### 6. MOD-06: Analytics Engine

Event tracking, metric aggregation, custom dashboards, and data export

#### Configuracion de Metricas Prometheus para MOD-06```yaml
# prometheus/rules/mod-06-alerts.yml
groups:
  - name: MOD-06_alerts
    rules:
      - alert: MOD-06HighErrorRate
        expr: |
          (
            sum(rate(http_requests_total{module="Analytics Engine",status=~"5.."}[5m]))
            /
            sum(rate(http_requests_total{module="Analytics Engine"}[5m]))
          ) > 0.05
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: critical
          team: backend
        annotations:
          summary: "Tasa de error alta en Analytics Engine"
          description: "Error rate de {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} supera 5%"
          runbook: "https://wiki.internal/runbooks/MOD-06-001"

      - alert: MOD-06HighLatencyP95
        expr: |
          histogram_quantile(0.95,
            sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{module="Analytics Engine"}[5m])) by (le)
          ) > 0.5
        for: 10m
        labels:
          severity: warning
          team: backend
        annotations:
          summary: "Latencia p95 alta en Analytics Engine"
          description: "p95 = {{ $value }}s (target: < 0.2s)"
          runbook: "https://wiki.internal/runbooks/MOD-06-002"

      - alert: MOD-06ServiceDown
        expr: up{job="analytics engine"} == 0
        for: 2m
        labels:
          severity: critical
          team: devops
        annotations:
          summary: "Analytics Engine no responde"
          description: "El modulo lleva 2 minutos sin responder"
          runbook: "https://wiki.internal/runbooks/MOD-06-005"

```

## Observabilidad — Tracing y Correlacion Avanzada — Detalle por Modulo

Las siguientes subsecciones proporcionan especificaciones detalladas para cada modulo funcional del sistema en el contexto de observabilidad — tracing y correlacion avanzada. Cada modulo incluye tablas de requisitos, matrices de trazabilidad, especificaciones tecnicas y criterios de aceptacion.

### 1. MOD-01: Core Application Service

Central orchestration of business logic and workflow coordination

#### Configuracion de Distributed Tracing para MOD-01La observabilidad del modulo Core Application Service se basa en los tres pilares: logs estructurados, metricas Prometheus/OpenTelemetry y distributed tracing con Jaeger/Tempo. La correlacion entre pilares se logra mediante la propagacion de contextos W3C Trace Context (traceparent, tracestate).

```typescript
// src/lib/telemetry/mod-01-tracing.ts

import { NodeSDK } from "@opentelemetry/sdk-node";
import { OTLPTraceExporter } from "@opentelemetry/exporter-trace-otlp-grpc";
import { HttpInstrumentation } from "@opentelemetry/instrumentation-http";
import { PrismaInstrumentation } from "@prisma/instrumentation";
import { RedisInstrumentation } from "@opentelemetry/instrumentation-redis-4";
import { BatchSpanProcessor, SimpleSpanProcessor, ConsoleSpanExporter } from "@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-base";

const MOD-01TracingSDK = new NodeSDK({
  serviceName: "SW-AOE-core application service",
  serviceVersion: process.env.APP_VERSION || "1.0.0",
  spanProcessors: [
    new BatchSpanProcessor(
      new OTLPTraceExporter({
        url: process.env.OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT || "http://tempo:4317",
      })
    ),
    ...(process.env.NODE_ENV === "development"
      ? [new SimpleSpanProcessor(new ConsoleSpanExporter())]
      : []),
  ],
  instrumentations: [
    new HttpInstrumentation({
      ignoreIncomingPaths: ["/health", "/ready", "/metrics"],
    }),
    new PrismaInstrumentation(),
    new RedisInstrumentation(),
  ],
  resource: new Resource({
    [SemanticResourceAttributes.SERVICE_NAME]: "Core Application Service",
    [SemanticResourceAttributes.DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT]: process.env.NODE_ENV,
    [SemanticResourceAttributes.SERVICE_VERSION]: process.env.APP_VERSION,
  }),
});

export function startCore Application ServiceTracing() {
  MOD-01TracingSDK.start();
  console.log("Core Application Service tracing initialized");
}

```

| ------------ | -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- | ----- | ------------ |
| GET /list    | MOD-01.http.get_list | validate, service.list, db.query, serialize                                          | http.method, http.status_code, db.system | cache.hit/miss                | N/A   | < 500ms      |
| POST /       | MOD-01.http.create   | validate, service.create, db.insert, cache.invalidate, event.emit, audit.log         | http.method, entity.id, entity.type      | validation.error              | N/A   | < 1000ms     |
| PUT /:id     | MOD-01.http.update   | validate, service.update, db.update, cache.invalidate, event.emit, audit.log         | http.method, entity.id, version          | optimistic.lock.error         | N/A   | < 800ms      |
| DELETE /:id  | MOD-01.http.delete   | authz.check, service.delete, db.soft_delete, cache.invalidate, event.emit, audit.log | http.method, entity.id, deletedBy        | authz.denied                  | N/A   | < 500ms      |
| POST /bulk   | MOD-01.http.bulk     | validate_batch, service.bulkCreate, db.transaction, event.bulk_emit                  | operation, itemCount                     | bulk.progress (each 100)      | N/A   | < 30000ms    |
| POST /export | MOD-01.http.export   | authz.check, service.export, file.generate, audit.log                                | format, recordCount                      | export.start, export.complete | N/A   | < 60000ms    |

### 6. MOD-06: Analytics Engine

Event tracking, metric aggregation, custom dashboards, and data export

#### Configuracion de Distributed Tracing para MOD-06La observabilidad del modulo Analytics Engine se basa en los tres pilares: logs estructurados, metricas Prometheus/OpenTelemetry y distributed tracing con Jaeger/Tempo. La correlacion entre pilares se logra mediante la propagacion de contextos W3C Trace Context (traceparent, tracestate).

```typescript
// src/lib/telemetry/mod-06-tracing.ts

import { NodeSDK } from "@opentelemetry/sdk-node";
import { OTLPTraceExporter } from "@opentelemetry/exporter-trace-otlp-grpc";
import { HttpInstrumentation } from "@opentelemetry/instrumentation-http";
import { PrismaInstrumentation } from "@prisma/instrumentation";
import { RedisInstrumentation } from "@opentelemetry/instrumentation-redis-4";
import { BatchSpanProcessor, SimpleSpanProcessor, ConsoleSpanExporter } from "@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-base";

const MOD-06TracingSDK = new NodeSDK({
  serviceName: "SW-AOE-analytics engine",
  serviceVersion: process.env.APP_VERSION || "1.0.0",
  spanProcessors: [
    new BatchSpanProcessor(
      new OTLPTraceExporter({
        url: process.env.OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT || "http://tempo:4317",
      })
    ),
    ...(process.env.NODE_ENV === "development"
      ? [new SimpleSpanProcessor(new ConsoleSpanExporter())]
      : []),
  ],
  instrumentations: [
    new HttpInstrumentation({
      ignoreIncomingPaths: ["/health", "/ready", "/metrics"],
    }),
    new PrismaInstrumentation(),
    new RedisInstrumentation(),
  ],
  resource: new Resource({
    [SemanticResourceAttributes.SERVICE_NAME]: "Analytics Engine",
    [SemanticResourceAttributes.DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT]: process.env.NODE_ENV,
    [SemanticResourceAttributes.SERVICE_VERSION]: process.env.APP_VERSION,
  }),
});

export function startAnalytics EngineTracing() {
  MOD-06TracingSDK.start();
  console.log("Analytics Engine tracing initialized");
}

```

## Caching — Estrategias Redis Avanzadas — Detalle por Modulo

Las siguientes subsecciones proporcionan especificaciones detalladas para cada modulo funcional del sistema en el contexto de caching — estrategias redis avanzadas. Cada modulo incluye tablas de requisitos, matrices de trazabilidad, especificaciones tecnicas y criterios de aceptacion.

### 1. MOD-01: Core Application Service

Central orchestration of business logic and workflow coordination

#### Configuracion de Redis Cluster para MOD-01```yaml
# redis/mod-01-redis.conf
# Configuracion de Redis para cache del modulo Core Application Service

bind: 0.0.0.0
port: 6379
requirepass: ${REDIS_PASSWORD}
masterauth: ${REDIS_PASSWORD}
protected-mode: yes

# Memoria
maxmemory: 2gb
maxmemory-policy: allkeys-lru
maxmemory-samples: 10

# Persistencia
save: 900 1
save: 300 10
save: 60 10000
appendonly: yes
appendfsync: everysec

# Red
tcp-backlog: 511
timeout: 300
tcp-keepalive: 60

# TLS
tls-port: 6380
tls-cert-file: /etc/redis/tls/redis.crt
tls-key-file: /etc/redis/tls/redis.key
tls-ca-cert-file: /etc/redis/tls/ca.crt
tls-auth-clients: yes

# Performance
hz: 10
lazyfree-lazy-eviction: yes
lazyfree-lazy-expire: yes

```

#### Patrones de Caching Avanzados para MOD-01| Patron                    | Operacion Aplicable      | Implementacion Redis                        | Consistencia            | Complejidad | Latencia Esperada           | Trade-off               |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ----------- | --------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| Cache-Aside               | GET /:id                 | GET key -> miss -> DB -> SET key            | Eventual (< TTL)        | Baja        | < 1ms (hit), < 200ms (miss) | Cache staleness         |
| Write-Through             | POST /, PUT /:id         | SET key + DB write en transaccion           | Strong                  | Media       | < 5ms (write)               | Write amplification     |
| Write-Behind              | POST /bulk               | SET key inmediato, DB write async via queue | Eventual (seconds)      | Alta        | < 1ms (write)               | Data loss risk          |
| Read-Through              | GET /list                | GET key -> miss -> cache-loader -> SET      | Eventual (< TTL)        | Media       | < 1ms (hit), < 200ms (miss) | First miss slower       |
| Refresh-Ahead             | GET metrics              | TTL/2 trigger async refresh                 | Near-real-time          | Alta        | < 1ms (always)              | Stale data for hot keys |
| Cache Stampede Protection | Popular entities         | SETNX lock + single flight                  | Eventual                | Alta        | < 2ms (under load)          | Lock overhead           |
| Multi-Tier                | Frequently accessed data | L1 (in-memory) -> L2 (Redis) -> L3 (DB)     | Eventual                | Alta        | < 0.1ms L1, < 1ms L2        | Invalidation complexity |
| Geo-Proximity             | Region-specific data     | Redis cluster per region + replication      | Eventual (cross-region) | Alta        | < 1ms (local region)        | Cross-region staleness  |

#### Implementacion de Cache Manager para MOD-01```typescript
// src/lib/cache/mod-01-cache-manager.ts

import Redis from "ioredis";
import { createHash } from "crypto";

export class Core Application ServiceCacheManager {
  private redis: Redis;
  private prefix: string;
  private defaultTTL: number;
  private locks: Map<string, string>;

  constructor(config: { redis: Redis; prefix?: string; defaultTTL?: number }) {
    this.redis = config.redis;
    this.prefix = config.prefix || "mod-01:";
    this.defaultTTL = config.defaultTTL || 300;
    this.locks = new Map();
  }

  private buildKey(pattern: string, ...args: (string | number)[]): string {
    const values = args.map((a) => String(a));
    if (values.some((v) => v.includes(":") || v.includes("*"))) {
      throw new Error("Cache key contains invalid characters");
    }
    return this.prefix + pattern.replace(/\{\d+\}/g, (_, i) => values[parseInt(i)] || "undefined");
  }

  async get<T>(key: string): Promise<T | null> {
    const fullKey = this.buildKey(key);
    const data = await this.redis.get(fullKey);
    if (!data) return null;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(data) as T;
    } catch {
      await this.redis.del(fullKey);
      return null;
    }
  }

  async set<T>(key: string, value: T, ttl?: number): Promise<void> {
    const fullKey = this.buildKey(key);
    const serialized = JSON.stringify(value);
    await this.redis.set(fullKey, serialized, "EX", ttl || this.defaultTTL);
  }

  async getOrSet<T>(
    key: string,
    loader: () => Promise<T>,
    ttl?: number
  ): Promise<T> {
    // 1. Intentar obtener del cache
    const cached = await this.get<T>(key);
    if (cached !== null) return cached;

    // 2. Cache stampede protection
    const lockKey = this.buildKey(key) + ":lock";
    const lockValue = Date.now().toString();
    const acquired = await this.redis.set(lockKey, lockValue, "NX", "EX", 10);

    if (acquired === "OK") {
      try {
        // Double-check after acquiring lock
        const doubleCheck = await this.get<T>(key);
        if (doubleCheck !== null) return doubleCheck;

        // Load from source
        const value = await loader();
        await this.set(key, value, ttl);
        return value;
      } finally {
        // Release lock (only if still ours)
        const currentLock = await this.redis.get(lockKey);
        if (currentLock === lockValue) {
          await this.redis.del(lockKey);
        }
      }
    }

    // 3. Wait and retry (short backoff)
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100));
    return this.getOrSet(key, loader, ttl);
  }

  async invalidate(key: string): Promise<void> {
    const fullKey = this.buildKey(key);
    await this.redis.del(fullKey);
  }

  async invalidateByTag(tag: string): Promise<void> {
    const pattern = this.prefix + "*:" + tag;
    const stream = this.redis.scanStream({ match: pattern, count: 100 });
    const pipeline = this.redis.pipeline();
    stream.on("data", (keys: string[]) => keys.forEach((k) => pipeline.del(k)));
    await new Promise((resolve) => stream.on("end", () => pipeline.exec().then(resolve)));
  }

  async invalidateAll(): Promise<void> {
    const pattern = this.prefix + "*";
    const stream = this.redis.scanStream({ match: pattern, count: 1000 });
    const pipeline = this.redis.pipeline();
    stream.on("data", (keys: string[]) => keys.forEach((k) => pipeline.del(k)));
    await new Promise((resolve) => stream.on("end", () => pipeline.exec().then(resolve)));
  }

  async getStats(): Promise<{
    hits: number; misses: number; hitRate: number; size: number; memory: string;
  }> {
    const info = await this.redis.info("stats");
    const keyspace = await this.redis.info("keyspace");
    const hits = parseInt(info.match(/keyspace_hits:(\d+)/)?.[1] || "0");
    const misses = parseInt(info.match(/keyspace_misses:(\d+)/)?.[1] || "0");
    return {
      hits,
      misses,
      hitRate: hits + misses > 0 ? hits / (hits + misses) : 0,
      size: parseInt(keyspace.match(/keys=(\d+)/)?.[1] || "0"),
      memory: info.match(/used_memory_human:(\S+)/)?.[1] || "0",
    };
  }
}

#### Patrones de Caching Avanzados para MOD-02| Patron                    | Operacion Aplicable      | Implementacion Redis                        | Consistencia            | Complejidad | Latencia Esperada           | Trade-off               |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ----------- | --------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| Cache-Aside               | GET /:id                 | GET key -> miss -> DB -> SET key            | Eventual (< TTL)        | Baja        | < 1ms (hit), < 200ms (miss) | Cache staleness         |
| Write-Through             | POST /, PUT /:id         | SET key + DB write en transaccion           | Strong                  | Media       | < 5ms (write)               | Write amplification     |
| Write-Behind              | POST /bulk               | SET key inmediato, DB write async via queue | Eventual (seconds)      | Alta        | < 1ms (write)               | Data loss risk          |
| Read-Through              | GET /list                | GET key -> miss -> cache-loader -> SET      | Eventual (< TTL)        | Media       | < 1ms (hit), < 200ms (miss) | First miss slower       |
| Refresh-Ahead             | GET metrics              | TTL/2 trigger async refresh                 | Near-real-time          | Alta        | < 1ms (always)              | Stale data for hot keys |
| Cache Stampede Protection | Popular entities         | SETNX lock + single flight                  | Eventual                | Alta        | < 2ms (under load)          | Lock overhead           |
| Multi-Tier                | Frequently accessed data | L1 (in-memory) -> L2 (Redis) -> L3 (DB)     | Eventual                | Alta        | < 0.1ms L1, < 1ms L2        | Invalidation complexity |
| Geo-Proximity             | Region-specific data     | Redis cluster per region + replication      | Eventual (cross-region) | Alta        | < 1ms (local region)        | Cross-region staleness  |

#### Implementacion de Cache Manager para MOD-02```typescript
// src/lib/cache/mod-02-cache-manager.ts

import Redis from "ioredis";
import { createHash } from "crypto";

export class Authentication ModuleCacheManager {
  private redis: Redis;
  private prefix: string;
  private defaultTTL: number;
  private locks: Map<string, string>;

  constructor(config: { redis: Redis; prefix?: string; defaultTTL?: number }) {
    this.redis = config.redis;
    this.prefix = config.prefix || "mod-02:";
    this.defaultTTL = config.defaultTTL || 300;
    this.locks = new Map();
  }

  private buildKey(pattern: string, ...args: (string | number)[]): string {
    const values = args.map((a) => String(a));
    if (values.some((v) => v.includes(":") || v.includes("*"))) {
      throw new Error("Cache key contains invalid characters");
    }
    return this.prefix + pattern.replace(/\{\d+\}/g, (_, i) => values[parseInt(i)] || "undefined");
  }

  async get<T>(key: string): Promise<T | null> {
    const fullKey = this.buildKey(key);
    const data = await this.redis.get(fullKey);
    if (!data) return null;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(data) as T;
    } catch {
      await this.redis.del(fullKey);
      return null;
    }
  }

  async set<T>(key: string, value: T, ttl?: number): Promise<void> {
    const fullKey = this.buildKey(key);
    const serialized = JSON.stringify(value);
    await this.redis.set(fullKey, serialized, "EX", ttl || this.defaultTTL);
  }

  async getOrSet<T>(
    key: string,
    loader: () => Promise<T>,
    ttl?: number
  ): Promise<T> {
    // 1. Intentar obtener del cache
    const cached = await this.get<T>(key);
    if (cached !== null) return cached;

    // 2. Cache stampede protection
    const lockKey = this.buildKey(key) + ":lock";
    const lockValue = Date.now().toString();
    const acquired = await this.redis.set(lockKey, lockValue, "NX", "EX", 10);

    if (acquired === "OK") {
      try {
        // Double-check after acquiring lock
        const doubleCheck = await this.get<T>(key);
        if (doubleCheck !== null) return doubleCheck;

        // Load from source
        const value = await loader();
        await this.set(key, value, ttl);
        return value;
      } finally {
        // Release lock (only if still ours)
        const currentLock = await this.redis.get(lockKey);
        if (currentLock === lockValue) {
          await this.redis.del(lockKey);
        }
      }
    }

    // 3. Wait and retry (short backoff)
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100));
    return this.getOrSet(key, loader, ttl);
  }

  async invalidate(key: string): Promise<void> {
    const fullKey = this.buildKey(key);
    await this.redis.del(fullKey);
  }

  async invalidateByTag(tag: string): Promise<void> {
    const pattern = this.prefix + "*:" + tag;
    const stream = this.redis.scanStream({ match: pattern, count: 100 });
    const pipeline = this.redis.pipeline();
    stream.on("data", (keys: string[]) => keys.forEach((k) => pipeline.del(k)));
    await new Promise((resolve) => stream.on("end", () => pipeline.exec().then(resolve)));
  }

  async invalidateAll(): Promise<void> {
    const pattern = this.prefix + "*";
    const stream = this.redis.scanStream({ match: pattern, count: 1000 });
    const pipeline = this.redis.pipeline();
    stream.on("data", (keys: string[]) => keys.forEach((k) => pipeline.del(k)));
    await new Promise((resolve) => stream.on("end", () => pipeline.exec().then(resolve)));
  }

  async getStats(): Promise<{
    hits: number; misses: number; hitRate: number; size: number; memory: string;
  }> {
    const info = await this.redis.info("stats");
    const keyspace = await this.redis.info("keyspace");
    const hits = parseInt(info.match(/keyspace_hits:(\d+)/)?.[1] || "0");
    const misses = parseInt(info.match(/keyspace_misses:(\d+)/)?.[1] || "0");
    return {
      hits,
      misses,
      hitRate: hits + misses > 0 ? hits / (hits + misses) : 0,
      size: parseInt(keyspace.match(/keys=(\d+)/)?.[1] || "0"),
      memory: info.match(/used_memory_human:(\S+)/)?.[1] || "0",
    };
  }
}

### 3. MOD-03: Authorization Engine

RBAC with hierarchical roles, permission inheritance, and resource-level policies

#### Configuracion de Redis Cluster para MOD-03```yaml
# redis/mod-03-redis.conf
# Configuracion de Redis para cache del modulo Authorization Engine

bind: 0.0.0.0
port: 6379
requirepass: ${REDIS_PASSWORD}
masterauth: ${REDIS_PASSWORD}
protected-mode: yes

# Memoria
maxmemory: 2gb

# Persistencia

lazyfree-lazy-expire: yes

#### Patrones de Caching Avanzados para MOD-03| Patron                    | Operacion Aplicable      | Implementacion Redis                        | Consistencia            | Complejidad | Latencia Esperada           | Trade-off               |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ----------- | --------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| Cache-Aside               | GET /:id                 | GET key -> miss -> DB -> SET key            | Eventual (< TTL)        | Baja        | < 1ms (hit), < 200ms (miss) | Cache staleness         |
| Write-Through             | POST /, PUT /:id         | SET key + DB write en transaccion           | Strong                  | Media       | < 5ms (write)               | Write amplification     |
| Write-Behind              | POST /bulk               | SET key inmediato, DB write async via queue | Eventual (seconds)      | Alta        | < 1ms (write)               | Data loss risk          |
| Read-Through              | GET /list                | GET key -> miss -> cache-loader -> SET      | Eventual (< TTL)        | Media       | < 1ms (hit), < 200ms (miss) | First miss slower       |
| Refresh-Ahead             | GET metrics              | TTL/2 trigger async refresh                 | Near-real-time          | Alta        | < 1ms (always)              | Stale data for hot keys |
| Cache Stampede Protection | Popular entities         | SETNX lock + single flight                  | Eventual                | Alta        | < 2ms (under load)          | Lock overhead           |
| Multi-Tier                | Frequently accessed data | L1 (in-memory) -> L2 (Redis) -> L3 (DB)     | Eventual                | Alta        | < 0.1ms L1, < 1ms L2        | Invalidation complexity |
| Geo-Proximity             | Region-specific data     | Redis cluster per region + replication      | Eventual (cross-region) | Alta        | < 1ms (local region)        | Cross-region staleness  |

#### Implementacion de Cache Manager para MOD-03```typescript
// src/lib/cache/mod-03-cache-manager.ts

import Redis from "ioredis";
import { createHash } from "crypto";

export class Authorization EngineCacheManager {
  private redis: Redis;
  private prefix: string;
  private defaultTTL: number;
  private locks: Map<string, string>;

  constructor(config: { redis: Redis; prefix?: string; defaultTTL?: number }) {
    this.redis = config.redis;
    this.prefix = config.prefix || "mod-03:";
    this.defaultTTL = config.defaultTTL || 300;
    this.locks = new Map();
  }

  private buildKey(pattern: string, ...args: (string | number)[]): string {
    const values = args.map((a) => String(a));
    if (values.some((v) => v.includes(":") || v.includes("*"))) {
      throw new Error("Cache key contains invalid characters");
    }
    return this.prefix + pattern.replace(/\{\d+\}/g, (_, i) => values[parseInt(i)] || "undefined");
  }

  async get<T>(key: string): Promise<T | null> {
    const fullKey = this.buildKey(key);
    const data = await this.redis.get(fullKey);
    if (!data) return null;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(data) as T;
    } catch {
      await this.redis.del(fullKey);
      return null;
    }
  }

  async set<T>(key: string, value: T, ttl?: number): Promise<void> {
    const fullKey = this.buildKey(key);
    const serialized = JSON.stringify(value);
    await this.redis.set(fullKey, serialized, "EX", ttl || this.defaultTTL);
  }

  async getOrSet<T>(
    key: string,
    loader: () => Promise<T>,
    ttl?: number
  ): Promise<T> {
    // 1. Intentar obtener del cache
    const cached = await this.get<T>(key);
    if (cached !== null) return cached;

    // 2. Cache stampede protection
    const lockKey = this.buildKey(key) + ":lock";
    const lockValue = Date.now().toString();
    const acquired = await this.redis.set(lockKey, lockValue, "NX", "EX", 10);

    if (acquired === "OK") {
      try {
        // Double-check after acquiring lock
        const doubleCheck = await this.get<T>(key);
        if (doubleCheck !== null) return doubleCheck;

        // Load from source
        const value = await loader();
        await this.set(key, value, ttl);
        return value;
      } finally {
        // Release lock (only if still ours)
        const currentLock = await this.redis.get(lockKey);
        if (currentLock === lockValue) {
          await this.redis.del(lockKey);
        }
      }
    }

    // 3. Wait and retry (short backoff)
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100));
    return this.getOrSet(key, loader, ttl);
  }

  async invalidate(key: string): Promise<void> {
    const fullKey = this.buildKey(key);
    await this.redis.del(fullKey);
  }

  async invalidateByTag(tag: string): Promise<void> {
    const pattern = this.prefix + "*:" + tag;
    const stream = this.redis.scanStream({ match: pattern, count: 100 });
    const pipeline = this.redis.pipeline();
    stream.on("data", (keys: string[]) => keys.forEach((k) => pipeline.del(k)));
    await new Promise((resolve) => stream.on("end", () => pipeline.exec().then(resolve)));
  }

  async invalidateAll(): Promise<void> {
    const pattern = this.prefix + "*";
    const stream = this.redis.scanStream({ match: pattern, count: 1000 });
    const pipeline = this.redis.pipeline();
    stream.on("data", (keys: string[]) => keys.forEach((k) => pipeline.del(k)));
    await new Promise((resolve) => stream.on("end", () => pipeline.exec().then(resolve)));
  }

  async getStats(): Promise<{
    hits: number; misses: number; hitRate: number; size: number; memory: string;
  }> {
    const info = await this.redis.info("stats");
    const keyspace = await this.redis.info("keyspace");
    const hits = parseInt(info.match(/keyspace_hits:(\d+)/)?.[1] || "0");
    const misses = parseInt(info.match(/keyspace_misses:(\d+)/)?.[1] || "0");
    return {
      hits,
      misses,
      hitRate: hits + misses > 0 ? hits / (hits + misses) : 0,
      size: parseInt(keyspace.match(/keys=(\d+)/)?.[1] || "0"),
      memory: info.match(/used_memory_human:(\S+)/)?.[1] || "0",
    };
  }
}

```

#### Topologia de Cache Distribuido para MOD-03```text
  Topologia de Cache — Modulo Authorization Engine

  [Client Browser]
       │ HTTP Cache (Cache-Control)
       ▼
  [CDN / CloudFront]
       │ Edge Cache (static assets, public data)
       ▼
  [API Server — L1 Cache]
       │ In-Memory LRU (Node.js Map, 100MB max)
       │ TTL: 60s, Eviction: LRU
       ▼
  [Redis Cluster — L2 Cache]
       │ 3 nodes (1 primary + 2 replicas)
       │ TTL: 5-15 min, Eviction: allkeys-lru
       │ Persistence: AOF everysec
       ▼
  [PostgreSQL — Source of Truth]
       │ Primary + 2 Read Replicas
       │ All writes go to primary

```

| Max Memory      | 50MB            | 500MB            | 2GB per node            | Ajustar por carga              |
| Default TTL     | 60s             | 300s             | 300s                    | Mas corto en dev para frescura |

| ------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ----------- | --------------------------- | ----------------------- |

| Refresh-Ahead             | GET metrics              | TTL/2 trigger async refresh                 | Near-real-time          | Alta        | < 1ms (always)              | Stale data for hot keys |
| Cache Stampede Protection | Popular entities         | SETNX lock + single flight                  | Eventual                | Alta        | < 2ms (under load)          | Lock overhead           |
| Multi-Tier                | Frequently accessed data | L1 (in-memory) -> L2 (Redis) -> L3 (DB)     | Eventual                | Alta        | < 0.1ms L1, < 1ms L2        | Invalidation complexity |
| Geo-Proximity             | Region-specific data     | Redis cluster per region + replication      | Eventual (cross-region) | Alta        | < 1ms (local region)        | Cross-region staleness  |

#### Implementacion de Cache Manager para MOD-04```typescript
// src/lib/cache/mod-04-cache-manager.ts

import Redis from "ioredis";
import { createHash } from "crypto";

export class Notification ServiceCacheManager {
  private redis: Redis;
  private prefix: string;
  private defaultTTL: number;
  private locks: Map<string, string>;

  constructor(config: { redis: Redis; prefix?: string; defaultTTL?: number }) {
    this.redis = config.redis;
    this.prefix = config.prefix || "mod-04:";
    this.defaultTTL = config.defaultTTL || 300;
    this.locks = new Map();
  }

  private buildKey(pattern: string, ...args: (string | number)[]): string {
    const values = args.map((a) => String(a));
    if (values.some((v) => v.includes(":") || v.includes("*"))) {
      throw new Error("Cache key contains invalid characters");
    }
    return this.prefix + pattern.replace(/\{\d+\}/g, (_, i) => values[parseInt(i)] || "undefined");
  }

  async get<T>(key: string): Promise<T | null> {
    const fullKey = this.buildKey(key);
    const data = await this.redis.get(fullKey);
    if (!data) return null;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(data) as T;
    } catch {
      await this.redis.del(fullKey);
      return null;
    }
  }

  async set<T>(key: string, value: T, ttl?: number): Promise<void> {
    const fullKey = this.buildKey(key);
    const serialized = JSON.stringify(value);
    await this.redis.set(fullKey, serialized, "EX", ttl || this.defaultTTL);
  }

  async getOrSet<T>(
    key: string,
    loader: () => Promise<T>,
    ttl?: number
  ): Promise<T> {
    // 1. Intentar obtener del cache
    const cached = await this.get<T>(key);
    if (cached !== null) return cached;

    // 2. Cache stampede protection
    const lockKey = this.buildKey(key) + ":lock";
    const lockValue = Date.now().toString();
    const acquired = await this.redis.set(lockKey, lockValue, "NX", "EX", 10);

    if (acquired === "OK") {
      try {
        // Double-check after acquiring lock
        const doubleCheck = await this.get<T>(key);
        if (doubleCheck !== null) return doubleCheck;

        // Load from source
        const value = await loader();
        await this.set(key, value, ttl);
        return value;
      } finally {
        // Release lock (only if still ours)
        const currentLock = await this.redis.get(lockKey);
        if (currentLock === lockValue) {
          await this.redis.del(lockKey);
        }
      }
    }

    // 3. Wait and retry (short backoff)
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100));
    return this.getOrSet(key, loader, ttl);
  }

  async invalidate(key: string): Promise<void> {
    const fullKey = this.buildKey(key);
    await this.redis.del(fullKey);
  }

  async invalidateByTag(tag: string): Promise<void> {
    const pattern = this.prefix + "*:" + tag;
    const stream = this.redis.scanStream({ match: pattern, count: 100 });
    const pipeline = this.redis.pipeline();
    stream.on("data", (keys: string[]) => keys.forEach((k) => pipeline.del(k)));
    await new Promise((resolve) => stream.on("end", () => pipeline.exec().then(resolve)));
  }

  async invalidateAll(): Promise<void> {
    const pattern = this.prefix + "*";
    const stream = this.redis.scanStream({ match: pattern, count: 1000 });
    const pipeline = this.redis.pipeline();
    stream.on("data", (keys: string[]) => keys.forEach((k) => pipeline.del(k)));
    await new Promise((resolve) => stream.on("end", () => pipeline.exec().then(resolve)));
  }

  async getStats(): Promise<{
    hits: number; misses: number; hitRate: number; size: number; memory: string;
  }> {
    const info = await this.redis.info("stats");
    const keyspace = await this.redis.info("keyspace");
    const hits = parseInt(info.match(/keyspace_hits:(\d+)/)?.[1] || "0");
    const misses = parseInt(info.match(/keyspace_misses:(\d+)/)?.[1] || "0");
    return {
      hits,
      misses,
      hitRate: hits + misses > 0 ? hits / (hits + misses) : 0,
      size: parseInt(keyspace.match(/keys=(\d+)/)?.[1] || "0"),
      memory: info.match(/used_memory_human:(\S+)/)?.[1] || "0",
    };
  }
}

#### Topologia de Cache Distribuido para MOD-04```text
  Topologia de Cache — Modulo Notification Service

  [Client Browser]
       │ HTTP Cache (Cache-Control)
       ▼
  [CDN / CloudFront]
       │ Edge Cache (static assets, public data)
       ▼
  [API Server — L1 Cache]
       │ In-Memory LRU (Node.js Map, 100MB max)
       │ TTL: 60s, Eviction: LRU
       ▼
  [Redis Cluster — L2 Cache]
       │ 3 nodes (1 primary + 2 replicas)
       │ TTL: 5-15 min, Eviction: allkeys-lru
       │ Persistence: AOF everysec
       ▼
  [PostgreSQL — Source of Truth]
       │ Primary + 2 Read Replicas
       │ All writes go to primary

bind: 0.0.0.0
port: 6379
requirepass: ${REDIS_PASSWORD}

protected-mode: yes

# Memoria

# Persistencia

#### Patrones de Caching Avanzados para MOD-05| Patron                    | Operacion Aplicable      | Implementacion Redis                        | Consistencia            | Complejidad | Latencia Esperada           | Trade-off               |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ----------- | --------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| Cache-Aside               | GET /:id                 | GET key -> miss -> DB -> SET key            | Eventual (< TTL)        | Baja        | < 1ms (hit), < 200ms (miss) | Cache staleness         |
| Write-Through             | POST /, PUT /:id         | SET key + DB write en transaccion           | Strong                  | Media       | < 5ms (write)               | Write amplification     |
| Write-Behind              | POST /bulk               | SET key inmediato, DB write async via queue | Eventual (seconds)      | Alta        | < 1ms (write)               | Data loss risk          |
| Read-Through              | GET /list                | GET key -> miss -> cache-loader -> SET      | Eventual (< TTL)        | Media       | < 1ms (hit), < 200ms (miss) | First miss slower       |
| Refresh-Ahead             | GET metrics              | TTL/2 trigger async refresh                 | Near-real-time          | Alta        | < 1ms (always)              | Stale data for hot keys |
| Cache Stampede Protection | Popular entities         | SETNX lock + single flight                  | Eventual                | Alta        | < 2ms (under load)          | Lock overhead           |
| Multi-Tier                | Frequently accessed data | L1 (in-memory) -> L2 (Redis) -> L3 (DB)     | Eventual                | Alta        | < 0.1ms L1, < 1ms L2        | Invalidation complexity |
| Geo-Proximity             | Region-specific data     | Redis cluster per region + replication      | Eventual (cross-region) | Alta        | < 1ms (local region)        | Cross-region staleness  |

#### Implementacion de Cache Manager para MOD-05```typescript
// src/lib/cache/mod-05-cache-manager.ts

import Redis from "ioredis";
import { createHash } from "crypto";

export class Search & Discovery ModuleCacheManager {
  private redis: Redis;
  private prefix: string;
  private defaultTTL: number;
  private locks: Map<string, string>;

  constructor(config: { redis: Redis; prefix?: string; defaultTTL?: number }) {
    this.redis = config.redis;
    this.prefix = config.prefix || "mod-05:";
    this.defaultTTL = config.defaultTTL || 300;
    this.locks = new Map();
  }

  private buildKey(pattern: string, ...args: (string | number)[]): string {
    const values = args.map((a) => String(a));
    if (values.some((v) => v.includes(":") || v.includes("*"))) {
      throw new Error("Cache key contains invalid characters");
    }
    return this.prefix + pattern.replace(/\{\d+\}/g, (_, i) => values[parseInt(i)] || "undefined");
  }

  async get<T>(key: string): Promise<T | null> {
    const fullKey = this.buildKey(key);
    const data = await this.redis.get(fullKey);
    if (!data) return null;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(data) as T;
    } catch {
      await this.redis.del(fullKey);
      return null;
    }
  }

  async set<T>(key: string, value: T, ttl?: number): Promise<void> {
    const fullKey = this.buildKey(key);
    const serialized = JSON.stringify(value);
    await this.redis.set(fullKey, serialized, "EX", ttl || this.defaultTTL);
  }

  async getOrSet<T>(
    key: string,
    loader: () => Promise<T>,
    ttl?: number
  ): Promise<T> {
    // 1. Intentar obtener del cache
    const cached = await this.get<T>(key);
    if (cached !== null) return cached;

    // 2. Cache stampede protection
    const lockKey = this.buildKey(key) + ":lock";
    const lockValue = Date.now().toString();
    const acquired = await this.redis.set(lockKey, lockValue, "NX", "EX", 10);

    if (acquired === "OK") {
      try {
        // Double-check after acquiring lock
        const doubleCheck = await this.get<T>(key);
        if (doubleCheck !== null) return doubleCheck;

        // Load from source
        const value = await loader();
        await this.set(key, value, ttl);
        return value;
      } finally {
        // Release lock (only if still ours)
        const currentLock = await this.redis.get(lockKey);
        if (currentLock === lockValue) {
          await this.redis.del(lockKey);
        }
      }
    }

    // 3. Wait and retry (short backoff)
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100));
    return this.getOrSet(key, loader, ttl);
  }

  async invalidate(key: string): Promise<void> {
    const fullKey = this.buildKey(key);
    await this.redis.del(fullKey);
  }

  async invalidateByTag(tag: string): Promise<void> {
    const pattern = this.prefix + "*:" + tag;
    const stream = this.redis.scanStream({ match: pattern, count: 100 });
    const pipeline = this.redis.pipeline();
    stream.on("data", (keys: string[]) => keys.forEach((k) => pipeline.del(k)));
    await new Promise((resolve) => stream.on("end", () => pipeline.exec().then(resolve)));
  }

  async invalidateAll(): Promise<void> {
    const pattern = this.prefix + "*";
    const stream = this.redis.scanStream({ match: pattern, count: 1000 });
    const pipeline = this.redis.pipeline();
    stream.on("data", (keys: string[]) => keys.forEach((k) => pipeline.del(k)));
    await new Promise((resolve) => stream.on("end", () => pipeline.exec().then(resolve)));
  }

  async getStats(): Promise<{
    hits: number; misses: number; hitRate: number; size: number; memory: string;
  }> {
    const info = await this.redis.info("stats");
    const keyspace = await this.redis.info("keyspace");
    const hits = parseInt(info.match(/keyspace_hits:(\d+)/)?.[1] || "0");
    const misses = parseInt(info.match(/keyspace_misses:(\d+)/)?.[1] || "0");
    return {
      hits,
      misses,
      hitRate: hits + misses > 0 ? hits / (hits + misses) : 0,
      size: parseInt(keyspace.match(/keys=(\d+)/)?.[1] || "0"),
      memory: info.match(/used_memory_human:(\S+)/)?.[1] || "0",
    };
  }
}
