## 18.2 Sistema de Webhooks
El sistema de webhooks permite que servicios externos reciban notificaciones en tiempo real sobre eventos del sistema. Cada webhook endpoint soporta configuracion de filtros, reintentos automaticos con backoff exponencial, firmas criptograficas HMAC-SHA256 para verificacion de autenticidad, y un dashboard de monitoreo de entregas.

| Webhook ID | Evento Fuente            | URL Target                    | Metodo | Autenticacion | Max Retries | Timeout | Payload Max |
| ---------- | ------------------------ | ----------------------------- | ------ | ------------- | ----------- | ------- | ----------- |
| WH-001     | entity.created           | /api/hooks/external/on-create | POST   | HMAC-SHA256   | 5           | 10s     | 1MB         |
| WH-002     | entity.status.changed    | /api/hooks/external/on-status | POST   | HMAC-SHA256   | 5           | 10s     | 512KB       |
| WH-003     | entity.deleted           | /api/hooks/external/on-delete | POST   | HMAC-SHA256   | 3           | 10s     | 256KB       |
| WH-004     | threshold.reached        | /api/hooks/external/on-alert  | POST   | Bearer Token  | 5           | 15s     | 256KB       |
| WH-005     | bulk.operation.completed | /api/hooks/external/on-bulk   | POST   | HMAC-SHA256   | 3           | 30s     | 5MB         |

```typescript
// Webhook delivery service for SW-AOE
interface WebhookConfig {
  id: string;
  url: string;
  events: string[];
  secret: string;          // HMAC signing secret
  active: boolean;
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  filters?: WebhookFilter[];
}

async function deliverWebhook(event: DomainEvent, config: WebhookConfig): Promise<WebhookResult> {
  const timestamp = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000).toString();
  const payload = JSON.stringify({ event, deliveredAt: new Date().toISOString() });
  const signature = createHmacSignature(payload, config.secret);

  const response = await fetch(config.url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "X-Webhook-Signature": signature,
      "X-Webhook-Timestamp": timestamp,
      "X-Event-ID": event.eventId,
      ...config.headers,
    },
    body: payload,
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000),
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new WebhookDeliveryError(response.status, await response.text());
  }

  return { success: true, statusCode: response.status, timestamp: Date.now() };
}

function createHmacSignature(payload: string, secret: string): string {
  return crypto.createHmac("sha256", secret).update(payload).digest("hex");
}

```

## 18.3 Anti-Corruption Layer (ACL)
La ACL traduce entre el modelo de dominio interno de SW-AOE y los modelos de datos de servicios externos. Cada adapter encapsula la logica de transformacion, validacion y normalizacion de datos, evitando que dependencias externas contaminen el dominio del negocio.

| Capa ACL         | Responsabilidad                      | Input               | Output                     | Validaciones                     | Error Handling                 |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------- | -------------------------- | -------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| Auth ACL         | Traducir tokens y claims             | JWT externo         | InternalUser               | Token format, expiration, issuer | Reject + log security          |
| Notification ACL | Normalizar formato de notificacion   | InternalEvent       | ExternalNotificationFormat | Payload size, fields required    | Queue for retry                |
| Search ACL       | Adaptar queries al formato del motor | SearchQuery interno | ExternalSearchRequest      | Query syntax, field mapping      | Fallback to local search       |
| Storage ACL      | Abstraccion de storage provider      | InternalFile        | ExternalStorageRequest     | File size, type, path            | Retry with exponential backoff |
| Payment ACL      | Mapeo de modelos financieros         | InternalTransaction | ExternalPaymentRequest     | Amount format, currency          | Reject + manual review         |

## 18.4 Patrones de Resiliencia: Circuit Breaker
Cada integracion externa esta protegida por un circuit breaker que monitorea la tasa de fallos y abre el circuito cuando se supera un umbral, redirigiendo el trafico a un fallback predefinido.

| Integracion          | Failure Threshold | Recovery Timeout | Half-Open Requests | Fallback Strategy                | Monitoring               |
| -------------------- | ----------------- | ---------------- | ------------------ | -------------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| Auth Service         | 3 fallos en 30s   | 60s              | 2                  | Cache de sesiones activas        | Dashboard + PagerDuty P1 |
| Notification Service | 10 fallos en 60s  | 120s             | 5                  | Cola offline con sync diferido   | Dashboard + Slack alert  |
| Search Engine        | 5 fallos en 30s   | 45s              | 3                  | Busqueda local en BD con LIKE    | Dashboard + PagerDuty P2 |
| File Storage         | 2 fallos en 60s   | 180s             | 1                  | Almacenamiento local temporal    | Dashboard + PagerDuty P1 |
| Audit System         | 5 fallos en 30s   | 60s              | 3                  | Log local + sync batch nocturno  | Dashboard + Slack alert  |
| Payment Gateway      | 1 fallo en 30s    | 300s             | 1                  | Rechazar transaccion + notificar | Dashboard + PagerDuty P0 |
| Email Service        | 10 fallos en 60s  | 300s             | 5                  | Cola offline de emails           | Dashboard + Slack alert  |
| SMS Gateway          | 15 fallos en 60s  | 600s             | 5                  | Notificacion in-app alternativa  | Dashboard + Slack alert  |

```typescript
// Circuit breaker state machine implementation
enum CircuitState { CLOSED = "closed", OPEN = "open", HALF_OPEN = "half-open" }

class CircuitBreaker {
  private state: CircuitState = CircuitState.CLOSED;
  private failureCount = 0;
  private successCount = 0;
  private lastFailureTime = 0;

  constructor(
    private config: {
      failureThreshold: number;
      recoveryTimeout: number;
      halfOpenMaxRequests: number;
    }
  ) {}

  async execute<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>, fallback: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    if (this.state === CircuitState.OPEN) {
      if (Date.now() - this.lastFailureTime > this.config.recoveryTimeout) {
        this.state = CircuitState.HALF_OPEN;
        this.successCount = 0;
      } else {
        return fallback();
      }
    }

    try {
      const result = await fn();
      this.onSuccess();
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      this.onFailure();
      return fallback();
    }
  }

  private onSuccess(): void {
    this.failureCount = 0;
    if (this.state === CircuitState.HALF_OPEN) {
      this.successCount++;
      if (this.successCount >= this.config.halfOpenMaxRequests) {
        this.state = CircuitState.CLOSED;
      }
    }
  }

  private onFailure(): void {
    this.failureCount++;
    this.lastFailureTime = Date.now();
    if (this.failureCount >= this.config.failureThreshold) {
      this.state = CircuitState.OPEN;
    }
  }
}

```

## 18.5 Politicas de Reintento por Integracion
| Integracion          | Max Retries | Initial Delay | Max Delay | Backoff Type | Jitter | Idempotency Key | Abort Conditions     |
| -------------------- | ----------- | ------------- | --------- | ------------ | ------ | --------------- | -------------------- |
| Auth Service         | 2           | 100ms         | 1s        | Fixed        | No     | requestId       | 401 permanent        |
| Notification Service | 5           | 1s            | 5min      | Exponential  | Full   | eventId         | 4xx no retry         |
| Search Engine        | 3           | 500ms         | 30s       | Exponential  | Full   | queryHash       | 400 bad query        |
| File Storage         | 3           | 1s            | 30s       | Exponential  | Full   | uploadId        | 413 file too large   |
| Audit System         | 5           | 500ms         | 60s       | Exponential  | Full   | eventId         | 415 unsupported type |
| Payment Gateway      | 1           | 5s            | 5s        | Fixed        | No     | transactionId   | Any 4xx              |
| Email Service        | 5           | 5s            | 10min     | Exponential  | Full   | messageId       | 422 invalid address  |
| SMS Gateway          | 3           | 2s            | 60s       | Exponential  | Full   | messageId       | 422 invalid number   |

# Seccion 19: Manejo de Errores
## 19.1 Taxonomia de Errores del Sistema
La taxonomia de errores de SW-AOE clasifica todos los errores posibles en una jerarquia de 5 niveles que determina la estrategia de manejo, notificacion, logging y recuperacion. Cada error tiene un codigo unico, una severidad asignada, y un playbook de mitigacion definido.

### Jerarquia de Clasificacion de Errores| Nivel | Categoria             | Codigo Prefijo | Severidad  | Ejemplo                        | Impacto Usuario         | Notificacion          |
| ----- | --------------------- | -------------- | ---------- | ------------------------------ | ----------------------- | --------------------- |
| L1    | Validacion de Entrada | E1xxx          | Baja       | Campo vacio requerido          | Mensaje de correccion   | Log DEBUG             |
| L2    | Reglas de Negocio     | E2xxx          | Media      | Estado invalido para operacion | Rechazo con explicacion | Log INFO + Audit      |
| L3    | Autenticacion         | E3xxx          | Alta       | Token expirado                 | Redirect a login        | Log WARN + Security   |
| L4    | Autorizacion          | E4xxx          | Alta       | Sin permisos                   | Acceso denegado         | Log WARN + Security   |
| L5    | Integracion Externa   | E5xxx          | Critica    | Servicio caido                 | Degradacion graceful    | Log ERROR + PagerDuty |
| L6    | Base de Datos         | E6xxx          | Critica    | Conexion perdida               | Retry transparente      | Log ERROR + PagerDuty |
| L7    | Infraestructura       | E7xxx          | Emergencia | Sin memoria                    | Modo emergencia         | Log FATAL + PagerDuty |
| L8    | Datos Corruptos       | E8xxx          | Alta       | Inconsistencia detectada       | Operacion bloqueada     | Log ERROR + Data Team |
| L9    | Concurrencia          | E9xxx          | Media      | Conflictos optimistic lock     | Reintentar              | Log INFO              |
| L10   | Timeout               | E0xxx          | Media      | Operacion lenta                | Reintentar o cancelar   | Log WARN + SLA        |

| ------ | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------ | ---- | ----- | ------------------------ | ----------------------- |
| E1001  | REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING   | Campo obligatorio no proporcionado   | 400  | No    | Completar campo          | Log DEBUG               |

## 19.2 Formato Estandarizado de Respuesta de Error
Todas las respuestas de error de la API siguen un formato estandarizado compatible con RFC 7807 (Problem Details for HTTP APIs), extendido con campos adicionales para trazabilidad y debug.

```typescript
// Standard error response for SW-AOE
interface ErrorResponse {
  type: string;              // URI del tipo de error (RFC 7807)
  title: string;             // Titulo corto del error
  status: number;            // Codigo HTTP
  detail: string;            // Descripcion legible para humanos
  instance: string;          // URI del request especifico
  code: string;              // Codigo interno (e.g., "E1001")
  timestamp: string;         // ISO 8601 UTC
  traceId: string;           // ID de traza distribuida
  correlationId: string;     // ID de correlacion
  path: string;              // Path del request
  method: string;            // Metodo HTTP
  errors?: Array<{           // Errores por campo (validacion)
    field: string;
    message: string;
    rejectedValue?: unknown;
    constraint?: string;
    code?: string;
  }>;
  metadata?: {               // Metadata adicional (debug)
    requestId: string;
    serverNode: string;
    environment: string;
    documentationUrl?: string;
    retryAfter?: number;      // Segundos hasta reintento
  };
}

// Error response examples:
// 400 Validation Error:
// {
//   "type": "https://sw-aoe.com/errors/validation",
//   "title": "Validation Error",
//   "status": 400,
//   "detail": "The request body contains invalid fields",
//   "instance": "/api/v1/resources",
//   "code": "E1001",
//   "traceId": "abc-123",
//   "errors": [
//     { "field": "name", "message": "Required field", "code": "E1001" },
//     { "field": "email", "message": "Invalid format", "rejectedValue": "bad", "code": "E1002" }
//   ]
// }

## 19.3 Global Error Handler Middleware
```typescript
// Global error handler middleware for SW-AOE
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { ZodError } from "zod";
import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";

type ErrorMap = Record<string, { status: number; logLevel: string; notify: boolean }>;

const errorConfig: ErrorMap = {
  E1001: { status: 400, logLevel: "debug", notify: false },
  E2001: { status: 422, logLevel: "info", notify: false },
  E3001: { status: 401, logLevel: "warn", notify: true },
  E4001: { status: 403, logLevel: "warn", notify: true },
  E5001: { status: 502, logLevel: "error", notify: true },
  E6001: { status: 503, logLevel: "error", notify: true },
  E7001: { status: 503, logLevel: "fatal", notify: true },
};

export function globalErrorHandler(error: unknown, request: NextRequest): NextResponse {
  const traceId = request.headers.get("x-trace-id") || crypto.randomUUID();
  const correlationId = request.headers.get("x-correlation-id") || crypto.randomUUID();

  // Zod validation errors
  if (error instanceof ZodError) {
    return NextResponse.json({
      type: "https://sw-aoe.com/errors/validation",
      title: "Validation Error",
      status: 400,
      detail: "Request validation failed",
      code: "E1001",
      traceId,
      correlationId,
      errors: error.errors.map(e => ({
        field: e.path.join("."),
        message: e.message,
        code: "E1001",
      })),
    }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Prisma database errors
  if (error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError) {
    const dbErrorMap: Record<string, string> = {
      P2002: "E1005",  // Unique constraint violation
      P2003: "E6003",  // Foreign key constraint
      P2025: "E1001",  // Record not found
    };
    const errorCode = dbErrorMap[error.code] || "E6001";
    const config = errorConfig[errorCode] || { status: 500, logLevel: "error", notify: true };
    logError(errorCode, error, traceId, config.logLevel);
    if (config.notify) notifyError(errorCode, error, traceId);
    return NextResponse.json({
      type: "https://sw-aoe.com/errors/database",
      title: "Database Error",
      status: config.status, code: errorCode,
      traceId, correlationId,
      detail: error.message,
    }, { status: config.status });
  }

  // Unknown errors
  logError("E7001", error, traceId, "fatal");
  notifyError("E7001", error, traceId);
  return NextResponse.json({
    type: "https://sw-aoe.com/errors/internal",
    title: "Internal Server Error",
    status: 500,
    detail: "An unexpected error occurred",
    code: "E7001",
    traceId, correlationId,
  }, { status: 500 });
}

```

## 19.4 Matriz de Degradacion Graceful
| Componente Fallido | Degradacion Nivel 1     | Degradacion Nivel 2            | Degradacion Nivel 3     | Recovery                 |
| ------------------ | ----------------------- | ------------------------------ | ----------------------- | ------------------------ |
| Base de Datos      | Read-only mode + cache  | Modo offline con datos locales | Maintenance page        | Auto-reconnect + resync  |
| Redis Cache        | Cache miss-through a BD | Local in-memory cache          | Sin cache               | Auto-reconnect           |
| Bus de Eventos     | Eventos en cola local   | Eventos en BD (polling)        | Sin eventos (sync mode) | Auto-reconnect + replay  |
| Servicio de Auth   | Sesion cache (30 min)   | Basic auth temporal            | Read-only publico       | Circuit breaker recovery |
| Motor de Busqueda  | BD LIKE fallback        | Busqueda deshabilitada         | Sin busqueda            | Auto-reconnect           |
| File Storage       | Upload local temporal   | Uploads deshabilitados         | Solo lectura            | Sync pendientes          |
| Notificaciones     | Cola offline            | Solo in-app                    | Sin notificaciones      | Batch replay             |
| Email Service      | SMS como backup         | In-app como backup             | Sin email               | Batch resend             |

## 19.6 Estrategia de Logging Estructurado
El logging estructurado sigue el patron de campos consistentes para facilitar la busqueda, agregacion y alerta automatica. Cada entrada de log incluye contexto de la solicitud, nivel de severidad, y metadatos de trazabilidad.

| Campo        | Tipo          | Ejemplo                    | Presente En               | Buscable |
| ------------ | ------------- | -------------------------- | ------------------------- | -------- |
| timestamp    | ISO 8601      | 2024-06-15T10:30:00.000Z   | Todos los logs            | Si       |
| level        | enum          | ERROR                      | Todos los logs            | Si       |
| message      | string        | Database connection failed | Todos los logs            | Si       |
| service      | string        | auth-service               | Todos los logs            | Si       |
| traceId      | string (uuid) | 550e8400-e29b-41d4-a716    | Todos los logs            | Si       |
| spanId       | string (hex)  | b7f6c1d2                   | Todos los logs            | Si       |
| userId       | string        | usr_abc123                 | Todos los logs de request | Si       |
| requestId    | string (uuid) | req_xyz789                 | Todos los logs de request | Si       |
| path         | string        | /api/v1/entities           | Todos los logs de request | Si       |
| method       | string        | POST                       | Todos los logs de request | Si       |
| statusCode   | number        | 500                        | Logs de response          | Si       |
| durationMs   | number        | 234                        | Todos los logs de request | Si       |
| errorCode    | string        | E6001                      | Solo logs de error        | Si       |
| errorMessage | string        | Connection refused         | Solo logs de error        | Si       |
| stackTrace   | string        | Error: ...\n  at ...       | Solo logs de error        | Si       |
| environment  | string        | production                 | Todos los logs            | Si       |

## 20.2 Escenarios de Concurrencia
| ID     | Escenario              | Condicion de Carrera                        | Estrategia                                    | Resultado                            | Prob. | Test      |
| ------ | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ----- | --------- |
| CC-001 | Double submit          | Usuario envia formulario 2x rapidamente     | Idempotency key en header + client debouncing | Solo 1 ejecucion                     | Alta  | TC-CC-001 |
| CC-002 | Edicion simultanea     | 2 usuarios editan mismo registro            | Optimistic locking con version check          | Segundo editor recibe conflict error | Media | TC-CC-002 |
| CC-003 | Creacion duplicada     | 2 procesos crean entidad con mismo key      | Unique constraint + UPSERT pattern            | Solo 1 registro creado               | Media | TC-CC-003 |
| CC-004 | Delete durante edit    | Registro eliminado mientras se edita        | Soft delete + existence check en save         | Error descriptivo al guardar         | Baja  | TC-CC-004 |
| CC-005 | Export durante cambios | Datos cambian durante exportacion           | Snapshot a timestamp fijo + transaction read  | Export consistente al snapshot       | Alta  | TC-CC-005 |
| CC-006 | Race en bulk update    | Bulk update + bulk delete simultaneos       | Distributed lock por operation ID             | Operaciones serializadas             | Baja  | TC-CC-006 |
| CC-007 | Counter increment      | Multiple procesos incrementan mismo counter | Atomic increment en BD + optimistic lock      | Counter correcto sin perdida         | Media | TC-CC-007 |
| CC-008 | Cache stampede         | Cache expira + multiples requests buscan BD | Mutex lock por key + singleflight pattern     | Solo 1 query a BD, resto esperan     | Alta  | TC-CC-008 |

```typescript
// Idempotency middleware for SW-AOE
import { nanoid } from "nanoid";

const processedRequests = new Map<string, { result: unknown; timestamp: number }>();
const IDEMPOTENCY_TTL = 60 * 60 * 1000; // 1 hora

export function idempotencyMiddleware() {
  return async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    const idempotencyKey = req.headers["x-idempotency-key"];
    if (!idempotencyKey) return next();

    const cacheKey = `${req.method}:${req.path}:${idempotencyKey}`;
    const cached = processedRequests.get(cacheKey);

    if (cached && Date.now() - cached.timestamp < IDEMPOTENCY_TTL) {
      return res.status(200).json(cached.result);
    }

    // Wrap response to cache result
    const originalJson = res.json.bind(res);
    res.json = (data: unknown) => {
      processedRequests.set(cacheKey, { result: data, timestamp: Date.now() });
      return originalJson(data);
    };

    next();
  };
}

// Singleflight pattern to prevent cache stampede
const inflightRequests = new Map<string, Promise<unknown>>();

export async function singleflight<T>(
  key: string,
  fn: () => Promise<T>
): Promise<T> {
  const existing = inflightRequests.get(key);
  if (existing) return existing as Promise<T>;

  const promise = fn().finally(() => {
    inflightRequests.delete(key);
  });

  inflightRequests.set(key, promise);
  return promise;
}

```

## 20.3 Casos Extremos de Seguridad
| Ataque               | Vector                    | Input Malicioso                         | Validacion                            | Proteccion                          | Resultado        |
| -------------------- | ------------------------- | --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| SQL Injection        | Parametros de API         | '; DROP TABLE users; --                 | Parameterized queries via Prisma      | Prisma ORM sanitiza automaticamente | Rechazado        |
| XSS Stored           | Campos de texto           | <script>alert(document.cookie)</script> | DOMPurify sanitization                | Sanitizado en save + render         | Escapado         |
| CSRF                 | Formularios POST          | Formulario desde dominio externo        | SameSite cookies + CSRF token         | Double-submit cookie pattern        | Rechazado        |
| Path Traversal       | Rutas de archivos         | ../../etc/passwd                        | Path normalization + allowlist        | Solo rutas permitidas               | Rechazado        |
| Command Injection    | Search queries            | ; rm -rf /                              | Input validation + sandbox            | Solo caracteres alfanumericos       | Rechazado        |

## 20.5 Casos Extremos de Internacionalizacion
| Caso                              | Descripcion                     | Ejemplo                           | Validacion                      | Resultado                |
| --------------------------------- | ------------------------------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| Right-to-Left (RTL)               | Texto en idioma RTL             | مرحبا بالعالمية                   | CSS direction:rtl + text-align  | Renderizado RTL correcto |
| Caracteres combinados             | Emojis con skin tones           | 👨🏽‍💼                           | UTF-8 codepoint length          | Aceptado                 |
| Texto multilinea                  | Campos con saltos de linea      | Linea 1\nLinea 2                  | Newline sanitization            | Aceptado (escaped)       |
| Fechas con zonas                  | Fecha con timezone diferente    | 2024-01-15T08:00:00-05:00         | Timezone parsing                | Normalizada a UTC        |
| Numeros con formato local         | Separadores de miles por locale | 1.234,56 o 1,234.56               | Intl.NumberFormat               | Formateado al locale     |
| Diferencia de calendario          | Calendario gregoriano vs otros  | Anno nuevo en enero vs septiembre | Calendar aware                  | Respetado                |
| Texto superscript/subscript       | Notacion matematica             | H₂O o x²                          | Unicode support                 | Renderizado              |
| Idiomas con caracteres especiales | Aleman con umlauts, turco con ı | Fußball, İstanbul                 | NFC normalization               | Normalizado              |
| Text direction mixto              | Texto con partes LTR y RTL      | Hello مرحبا World                 | Unicode Bidirectional algorithm | Renderizado mixto        |

## 20.6 Escenarios de Fallo en Cadena de Dependencias
| Punto de Fallo      | Componente                 | Modo de Fallo | Impacto                                | Recovery                      | Tiempo Estimado |
| ------------------- | -------------------------- | ------------- | -------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- | --------------- |
| Nube caido          | Toda la app                | Total         | Sitio no disponible                    | Failover a DR                 | < 5 min         |
| DB no responde      | Read models + write models | Total         | No se pueden leer datos                | Read replica promotion        | < 2 min         |
| Redis no responde   | Cache + sesiones + queue   | Parcial       | Perdida de cache, sesiones invalidadas | Restart Redis + rebuild cache | < 10 min        |
| Auth service caido  | Autenticacion              | Parcial       | Login no funciona                      | Cached sessions (30 min)      | 30 min          |
| Storage caido       | Upload/download            | Parcial       | No se pueden subir archivos            | Upload local + sync           | < 30 min        |
| Email service caido | Notificaciones             | Parcial       | No emails enviados                     | Queue offline + resend        | < 1 hora        |
| CDN caido           | Assets estaticos           | Parcial       | CSS/JS sin cache, latencia alta        | Fallback a origen             | < 1 min         |
| DNS error           | Resolucion de nombres      | Total         | No se puede resolver dominio           | Fallback DNS provider         | < 5 min         |


# Seccion 21: Escalabilidad
## 21.1 Estrategia de Escalado Horizontal
El escalado horizontal permite agregar instancias adicionales del servidor de aplicacion para manejar incrementos de carga sin modificar el tamano de las instancias existentes. La arquitectura esta disenada para ser stateless a nivel de aplicacion, delegando todo el estado a servicios externos (Redis, PostgreSQL).

| Componente       | Min Instancias | Max Instancias | Trigger Scale Up                | Trigger Scale Down                 | Cooldown           |
| ---------------- | -------------- | -------------- | ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------------------ |
| App Server (API) | 2              | 20             | CPU > 70% por 5 min             | CPU < 30% por 15 min               | 300s up, 300s down |
| Queue Worker     | 1              | 10             | Queue depth > 500               | Queue depth < 50 por 10 min        | 120s up, 600s down |
| WebSocket Server | 1              | 5              | Connections > 1000 per instance | Connections < 200 per instance     | 300s               |
| Cron Scheduler   | 1              | 3              | Overdue tasks > 50              | No scale down (ha leader election) | N/A                |

### Configuracion de Auto-Scaling (Kubernetes HPA)```yaml
# Horizontal Pod Autoscaler for SW-AOE
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: sw-aoe-api-hpa
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: sw-aoe-api
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 20
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 70
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: memory
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 80
  - type: Pods
    pods:
      metric:
        name: http_requests_per_second
      target:
        type: AverageValue
        averageValue: 500
  behavior:
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 60
      policies:
      - type: Percent
        value: 100
        periodSeconds: 60
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
      policies:
      - type: Percent
        value: 25
        periodSeconds: 120

```

## 21.2 Escalado Vertical
| Nivel      | vCPU | RAM   | Storage    | Network  | Caso de Uso                  | Costo/mes |
| ---------- | ---- | ----- | ---------- | -------- | ---------------------------- | --------- |
| Starter    | 1    | 2 GB  | 20 GB SSD  | Moderada | Desarrollo y testing         | $20       |
| Standard   | 2    | 4 GB  | 50 GB SSD  | Alta     | Staging y produccion inicial | $50       |
| High       | 4    | 16 GB | 200 GB SSD | Muy alta | Produccion con carga media   | $150      |
| Ultra      | 8    | 32 GB | 500 GB SSD | Premium  | Produccion con carga alta    | $300      |
| Enterprise | 16   | 64 GB | 1 TB NVMe  | Dedicada | Produccion critica           | $600      |

## 21.3 Escalado de Base de Datos
| Estrategia               | Implementacion                                    | Beneficio                                        | Complejidad | Fase          |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ----------- | ------------- |
| Connection Pooling       | PgBouncer con pool_mode=transaction               | Hasta 10x mas conexiones con mismo DB            | Baja        | Actual        |
| Read Replicas            | 3 replicas de lectura via streaming replication   | Offload lecturas de la primaria                  | Media       | Mes 3         |
| Query Optimization       | Indices compuestos + ANALYZE + pg_stat_statements | Mejora de 10-100x en queries lentas              | Baja        | Actual        |
| Table Partitioning       | Particion por rango de fechas en tablas grandes   | Queries en particiones = queries en subconjuntos | Media       | Mes 6         |
| Connection Pooling (App) | Prisma pool: min 2, max 20, idle_timeout 30s      | Overhead reducido por conexion                   | Baja        | Actual        |
| Sharding por Tenant      | Citus extension para sharding horizontal          | Escalado lineal con tenants                      | Alta        | Futuro (v2.0) |
| Materialized Views       | Vistas materializadas para reportes               | Queries de reporte en ms en vez de minutos       | Baja        | Mes 3         |

## 21.4 Plan de Pruebas de Carga
| Escenario    | Usuarios      | Duracion | Ramp-up | Metrica Objetivo                 | Frecuencia |
| ------------ | ------------- | -------- | ------- | -------------------------------- | ---------- |
| Carga normal | 100           | 30 min   | 5 min   | p95 < 200ms, 0 errors            | Semanal    |
| Carga pico   | 500           | 15 min   | 2 min   | p95 < 500ms, < 1% errors         | Semanal    |
| Pico extremo | 2000          | 10 min   | 1 min   | Zero crash, graceful degradation | Mensual    |
| Endurance    | 200           | 4 horas  | 10 min  | Sin degradacion, sin memory leak | Mensual    |
| Stress       | 5000          | 30 min   | 5 min   | Recovery < 60s post-peak         | Trimestral |
| Spike        | 0→3000 en 30s | 10 min   | 30s     | Auto-scale completa en < 3 min   | Trimestral |
| Soak         | 500           | 24 horas | 30 min  | Sin degradation, memoria estable | Trimestral |

## 21.5 Planificacion de Capacidad
| Recurso               | Mes 1   | Mes 3   | Mes 6     | Mes 12     | Metrica            |
| --------------------- | ------- | ------- | --------- | ---------- | ------------------ |
| Usuarios concurrentes | 100     | 500     | 2,000     | 10,000     | Conexiones activas |
| Requests/segundo      | 50      | 200     | 1,000     | 5,000      | API throughput     |
| Registros totales     | 10,000  | 100,000 | 1,000,000 | 10,000,000 | DB row count       |
| Almacenamiento        | 1 GB    | 10 GB   | 50 GB     | 200 GB     | Disk usage         |
| Ancho de banda        | 10 Mbps | 50 Mbps | 200 Mbps  | 1 Gbps     | Network I/O        |
| Jobs en cola/dia      | 1,000   | 10,000  | 100,000   | 1,000,000  | Queue throughput   |

## 21.6 Estrategia de Sharding
El sharding permite distribuir datos horizontalmente entre multiples instancias de base de datos, escalando linealmente tanto la capacidad de escritura como de lectura.

| Estrategia      | Shard Key                   | Beneficio                       | Complejidad | Fase        |
| --------------- | --------------------------- | ------------------------------- | ----------- | ----------- |
| Hash-based      | HASH(projectId)             | Distribucion uniforme           | Baja        | Futuro      |
| Range-based     | RANGO(createdDate)          | Queries por rango eficientes    | Media       | Futuro      |
| Tenant-based    | TENANT(tenantId)            | Aislamiento completo por tenant | Alta        | Futuro (v2) |
| Directory-based | HASH(moduleType + entityId) | Queries por modulo optimizadas  | Media       | Futuro      |

## 21.7 Principios de Diseno Stateless
Para permitir escalado horizontal sin afinidad de sesiones, la aplicacion sigue principios estrictos de statelessness.

| Principio                 | Descripcion                                      | Implementacion         | Estado   | Validacion      |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------- | -------- | --------------- |
| No session en servidor    | Las sesiones se almacenan en JWT en el cliente   | httpOnly cookies + JWT | Cumplido | Audit quarterly |
| No estado en memoria      | Los datos de request se pasan como argumentos    | Functional programming | Cumplido | Code review     |
| Cache en servicio externo | Redis como cache compartido                      | Redis con TTL          | Cumplido | Config check    |
| Sin local files           | Todos los archivos van a S3/object storage       | S3/MinIO client        | Cumplido | Dep scan        |
| Connection pooling        | Las conexiones a DB se comparten via pool        | PgBouncer              | Cumplido | Health check    |
| Idempotent requests       | Reintentos no causan efectos duplicados          | Idempotency key        | Cumplido | Test coverage   |
| Graceful shutdown         | Las instancias completan trabajos antes de salir | SIGTERM handler        | Cumplido | Chaos test      |
| Health checks             | Endpoints de salud para LB decisions             | /api/health            | Cumplido | LB config       |

## 21.8 Anti-Patrones de Escalado
| Anti-Patron                | Descripcion                       | Problema                    | Solucion Correcta                      | Deteccion                          |
| -------------------------- | --------------------------------- | --------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| Stateful scaling           | Escalar con sesiones en memoria   | Lost sessions on scale down | External session store (Redis)         | Health check + sticky session test |
| Database connection leak   | No cerrar conexiones BD           | Pool exhaustion             | Connection pool with limits + timeouts | Pool metrics alert                 |
| Select N+1                 | N queries por listado de N items  | O(N) queries por page load  | Eager loading + join                   | Query analyzer                     |
| Monolithic DB bottleneck   | Un solo DB para todo              | Write contention extrema    | Read replicas + CQRS                   | DB load metrics                    |
| Cache without invalidation | Cache que nunca expira            | Stale data                  | TTL + event-driven invalidation        | Staleness check                    |
| Horizontal scaling limit   | Max instancias por quota de cloud | Cannot scale beyond limit   | Multi-region + cluster federation      | Quota monitoring                   |
| Load balancer uneven dist  | Distribucion desigual de trafico  | Hot instances               | Least-connections algorithm            | Instance CPU comparison            |


# Seccion 22: Rendimiento
## 22.1 Presupuestos de Rendimiento (Performance Budgets)
Los presupuestos de rendimiento definen los limites maximos aceptables para cada operacion del sistema. Estos budgets se verifican automaticamente en CI/CD y cualquier regresion bloquea el deploy a produccion.

| Operacion            | p50     | p95     | p99     | p99.9   | Throughput    | Timeout |
| -------------------- | ------- | ------- | ------- | ------- | ------------- | ------- |
| GET /list (20 items) | < 50ms  | < 100ms | < 200ms | < 500ms | 100 req/s     | 2s      |
| GET /detail/:id      | < 30ms  | < 80ms  | < 150ms | < 300ms | 200 req/s     | 2s      |
| POST /create         | < 100ms | < 200ms | < 500ms | < 1s    | 50 req/s      | 5s      |
| PUT /update/:id      | < 100ms | < 200ms | < 500ms | < 1s    | 50 req/s      | 5s      |
| DELETE /delete/:id   | < 50ms  | < 100ms | < 200ms | < 500ms | 30 req/s      | 2s      |
| POST /search         | < 100ms | < 300ms | < 500ms | < 1s    | 30 req/s      | 5s      |
| POST /bulk           | < 1s    | < 3s    | < 5s    | < 10s   | 2 req/min     | 30s     |
| POST /export         | < 2s    | < 5s    | < 10s   | < 30s   | 5 req/min     | 60s     |
| POST /upload         | < 3s    | < 5s    | < 10s   | < 30s   | 10 concurrent | 60s     |
| GET /metrics         | < 200ms | < 500ms | < 1s    | < 3s    | 20 req/min    | 10s     |

## 22.3 Estrategia de Caching Multi-Capa
| Capa                | Tecnologia                  | TTL          | Max Entries | Invalidation               | Hit Rate Target | Latencia    |
| ------------------- | --------------------------- | ------------ | ----------- | -------------------------- | --------------- | ----------- |
| L1 - Browser        | HTTP Cache + Service Worker | 1 hora       | N/A         | ETag + version hash        | 50%             | 0ms (local) |
| L2 - CDN Edge       | CloudFlare edge cache       | 1 hora       | Ilimitado   | Cache busting por deploy   | 80%             | < 50ms      |
| L3 - API Response   | Redis / In-memory           | 60s          | 10,000      | TTL + write-through        | 70%             | < 5ms       |
| L4 - Application    | LRU cache in Node.js        | 30s          | 1,000       | Event-driven + TTL         | 60%             | < 1ms       |
| L5 - Database Query | Prisma query cache          | 10s          | 500 queries | Write-through invalidation | 40%             | < 50ms      |
| L6 - Compiled       | Next.js build cache         | Hasta deploy | Infinito    | Build hash invalidation    | 99%             | 0ms         |

## 22.6 Patrones de Optimizacion de Queries
```sql
-- Optimized query patterns for SW-AOE
-- Pattern 1: Cursor-based pagination (avoid offset)
SELECT e.*, COUNT(*) OVER() AS total_count
FROM entities e
WHERE e.project_id = $1 AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY e.created_at DESC
FETCH FIRST 21 ONLY;  -- Fetch 20 + 1 for has-next check

-- Pattern 2: Covering index for filtered queries
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_sw-aoe_project_status_created
  ON entities(project_id, status, created_at DESC)
  INCLUDE (name, description, priority);

-- Pattern 3: Batch update with CTE
WITH batch AS (
  UPDATE entities
  SET priority = data.priority
  WHERE id = ANY(data.ids) AND deleted_at IS NULL
  RETURNING id, name, priority
)
SELECT * FROM batch;

-- Pattern 4: Materialized view for aggregation
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_sw-aoe_status_summary
AS SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count, MAX(created_at) as last_updated
FROM entities WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY status;
REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_sw-aoe_status_summary
CONCURRENTLY WITH;

```

# Seccion 23: Infraestructura
## 23.1 Arquitectura de Infraestructura
La infraestructura de SW-AOE sigue un modelo de nubes hibridas con componentes en cloud y opcion on-premise. Todos los recursos se definen como codigo (Infrastructure as Code) para garantizar reproducibilidad y auditabilidad.

```ascii
  ┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │                        CDN (CloudFlare)                        │
  │              Static assets, DDoS protection, WAF                │
  └──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┘
                             │
  ┌──────────────────────────▼──────────────────────────────────────┐
  │                    Load Balancer (nginx/ALB)                   │
  │            TLS termination, rate limiting, health checks        │
  └──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┘
                             │
  ┌──────────┬───────────────┼──────────────┬───────────────────────┐
  │  App 1   │   App 2       │   App 3      │   App N (HPA)        │
  │ (Node)   │   (Node)      │   (Node)     │   (auto-scaled)      │
  └────┬─────┴──────┬───────┴──────┬───────┴──────┬────────────────┘
       │            │              │              │
  ┌────▼────────────▼──────────────▼──────────────▼────────────────┐
  │              PostgreSQL (Primary + Replicas)                   │
  │            PgBouncer connection pooling                       │
  └──────┬───────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────┘
         │                           │
  ┌──────▼──────┐              ┌──────▼──────┐
  │ Redis      │              │ Redis      │
  │ (Cache)    │              │ (Queue)    │
  └─────────────┘              └─────────────┘

```

## 23.2 Configuracion Docker
```dockerfile
# Multi-stage Dockerfile for SW-AOE
# Stage 1: Dependencies
FROM node:20-alpine AS deps
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml .
RUN corepack enable pnpm && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prod=false

# Stage 2: Build
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY . .
RUN corepack enable pnpm && pnpm build

# Stage 3: Production
FROM node:20-alpine AS runner
WORKDIR /app

ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1

RUN addgroup --system --gid 1001 nodejs
RUN adduser --system --uid 1001 nextjs

COPY --from=builder /app/public ./public
COPY --from=builder --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/.next/standalone .
COPY --from=builder --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/.next/static ./.next/static

USER nextjs
EXPOSE 3000
ENV PORT=3000
ENV HOSTNAME="0.0.0.0"

CMD ["node", "server.js"]
```

### Docker Compose (Desarrollo)```yaml
# docker-compose.yml for SW-AOE development
version: "3.9"
services:
  app:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:5432/sw-aoe
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      - NODE_ENV=development
    depends_on:
      - postgres
      - redis
    volumes:
      - .:/app
      - /app/node_modules
    restart: unless-stopped

  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_DB=sw-aoe
      - POSTGRES_USER=postgres
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=devpassword
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    restart: unless-stopped

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    volumes:
      - redisdata:/data
    command: redis-server --appendonly yes --maxmemory 256mb --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  pgdata:
  redisdata:
```

## 23.4 Configuracion Nginx
```nginx
# /etc/nginx/sites-available/sw-aoe.conf
upstream sw-aoe_app {
    least_conn;
    server 127.0.0.1:3000;
    server 127.0.0.1:3001;
    keepalive 64;
}

server {
    listen 80;
    server_name sw-aoe.example.com;
    return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
}

server {
    listen 443 ssl http2;
    server_name sw-aoe.example.com;

    ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/sw-aoe/fullchain.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/sw-aoe/privkey.pem;
    ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
    ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5;
    ssl_prefer_server_ciphers off;
    ssl_session_cache shared:SSL:10m;
    ssl_session_timeout 10m;
    add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload" always;

    # Security headers
    add_header X-Frame-Options DENY always;
    add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always;
    add_header X-XSS-Protection "1; mode=block" always;
    add_header Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin" always;

    # Gzip compression
    gzip on;
    gzip_vary on;
    gzip_proxied any;
    gzip_comp_level 6;
    gzip_types text/plain text/css application/json application/javascript text/xml;

    # Rate limiting
    limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=api:10m rate=100r/m;
    limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=auth:10m rate=10r/m;

    # Static files
    location /_next/static {
        proxy_pass http://sw-aoe_app;
        proxy_cache_valid 200 365d;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable";
    }

    # API
    location /api/ {
        limit_req zone=api burst=20 nodelay;
        proxy_pass http://sw-aoe_app;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_cache_bypass $http_upgrade;
    }

    # Auth endpoints (stricter rate limit)
    location /api/auth/ {
        limit_req zone=auth burst=5 nodelay;
        proxy_pass http://sw-aoe_app;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
    }

    # Fallback
    location / {
        proxy_pass http://sw-aoe_app;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }
}
```

## 23.6 Seguridad de Infraestructura
| Medida              | Implementacion                     | Alcance                   | Frecuencia de Audit    | Responsable |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------------------------- | ---------------------- | ----------- |
| TLS 1.3             | nginx config + Lets Encrypt        | Todo el trafico HTTPS     | Continuo (cert expiry) | DevOps      |
| WAF Rules           | CloudFlare WAF + OWASP rules       | Todo el trafico HTTP      | Mensual                | Security    |
| DDoS Protection     | CloudFlare DDoS auto-mitigation    | Capa de red               | Continuo               | Infra       |
| Network Policies    | Kubernetes NetworkPolicy           | Pod-to-Pod communication  | Semanal                | DevOps      |
| Secrets Management  | Vault / AWS Secrets Manager        | Todas las credenciales    | Trimestral             | Security    |
| Container Scanning  | Trivy + Snyk en CI/CD              | Todas las imagenes Docker | Cada build             | DevOps      |
| SSH Hardening       | Ed25519 + fail2ban + no root login | Acceso a servidores       | Mensual                | Infra       |
| Firewall Rules      | UFW con solo puertos necesarios    | Todos los servidores      | Mensual                | Infra       |
| Intrusion Detection | Fail2ban + OSSEC                   | Todos los servidores      | Continuo               | Security    |
| Patch Management    | Automated security updates         | Todas las dependencias    | Semanal                | DevOps      |
